Shafer 比较了 GC/FTIR 和 GC/MS 方法在鉴定未知 text
物方面的能力。用 GC/FTIR 检测的 44 个化合物中，有 28 个化合物是完全被鉴定，占总数的 64%。有 9 个（占 34%）化合物是部分被鉴定，即没有完全确定。只有 1 个没有鉴定；而 GC/MS 法对检出的 44 个化合物，完全确定鉴定结果的是 13 个，部分鉴定的是 23 个，8 个不能鉴定。 text
第四节 废水有机物组成测定 text
用在有害废物监测的 GC/FTIR 和用在废水有机物组成分析的 GC/FTIR 方法基本是相同的。主要差别是有机物的提取和浓集方法的不同。比较早的工作有 Shafer
equation_inline
^{[40,41]}
text
用 GC/FTIR 和 HPLC/FTIR 等方法分析一个化工厂废水，该化工厂生产硝基苯、二氯苯、邻-硝基酚、苯胺和油添加剂。比较 GC/FTIR 和 HPLC/FTIR 两种方法，显然前者的灵敏度比 HPLC/FTIR 高 2—3 个量级，且后者在分析光谱时必须减去溶剂光谱，只有极少数的情况（如分析氯代硝基苯的异构体）用 HPLC 分离比 GC 分离为好。Shafer 分析化工厂废水的二氯甲烷提取液，经气相色谱分离出现 9 种取代的芳香化合物，各分离部分的光谱表明，分别是对-二氯苯、间-氯代硝基苯、对-氯代硝基苯、邻-氯代硝基苯、3,4-二氯代硝基苯，2,4-二氯代-6-硝基苯胺、三氯代硝基苯、烷基酞酸酯和磷酸三苯酯。 text
Azarrage 和 Potter 发展一种新的 GC/FTIR 分析系统，用于环境样品分析
equation_inline
^{[42]}
text
。气相色谱部分由两个色谱柱组成，以便用于分离复杂的样品。其中一个是 SP-2250 玻璃 SCOT 柱，另一个是 OV-101 弹性石英 WCOT 柱。图 11-40 和图 11-41 是油墨和印刷工业废水提取液样品，分别单独使用 OV-101 柱，或 SP-2250 柱分离时的 GC/FTIR 谱图。使用双柱分离时，先经 SP-2250 柱，把 850 秒后流出的组分分出，用一个冷阱收集它，重复收集 4 次，以达到浓集的目的。然后把冷阱收集的组分急骤蒸发，导入 OV-101 柱。经两柱分离后得到的谱图给于图 11-42。

equation_inline
30\times10^{14}kg
text
有机碳，而其中有60—80%的土壤有机碳是腐殖物质。研究腐殖酸的方法很多，但采用傅里叶变换红外光谱法研究土壤腐殖物质只是近年来的事。 text

record.caption_or_context:

§4-1 晶体红外光谱特点 text
第二部分 矿物红外光谱各论 text
第四章 矿物红外光谱概述 text
§4-1 晶体红外光谱特点 text
分子振动模式和频率决定矿物红外光谱的特点。分子振动模式取决于分子的几何构型和对称性，同一构型但不同对称的分子，其红外活性谱带数目、简并分裂程度有较大差别，并产生不同特征的红外光谱。分子伸缩(价键)振动是原子沿价键方向来回运动所引起的键长变化；弯曲(变形)振动是原子垂直子价键方向作相对运动时所引起的键角变化。键长、键角的改变依赖于化学键的强度，因此，分子振动频率与化学键强度密切相关，所以，在分析矿物红外光谱时，矿物中不同键的强度差异大小有着很重要的意义。大多数矿物化学式可以写成
equation_inline
A_{a}B_{b}\cdots X_{n}
text
，其中A、B、…为阳离子，X为阴离子(最常见为氧)。A、B、…与X的键强度是不同的，大致可以分为以下两种情况： text
第一种情况 大多数矿物，如碳酸盐、硫酸盐、磷酸盐、硅酸盐及硼酸盐等，其中B—X键比A—X…键强得多，也就是说，晶体结构中可以分出络阴离子或“封闭”的基团
equation_inline
[BX_{n}]
text
。如
equation_inline
CO_{3}^{2-}
text
、
equation_inline
SO_{4}^{2-}
text
、
equation_inline
PO_{4}^{3-}
text
、
equation_inline
SiO_{4}^{3-}
text
及
equation_inline
BO_{3}^{3-}
text
等。这些基团内部主要为共价键，其外部阳离子为离子键。基团内原子间的结合力比基团之间大得多，故可以把基团看成是一个独立单位。这些基团内部的振动称为内振动，振动模式及谱带数决定于基团本身的构型及晶胞的对称性。其频率较高，一般位于1500～600cm
equation_inline
^{-1}
text
范围内。虽然这些基团处在周围由阳离子所构成的晶体场中，振动频率会受到周围环境的影响，但是它的频率主要取决于内部坚固的共价键，晶体场的影响是次要的，故频率较稳定。大量红外光谱实验证实，每种基团，在不同化合物中频率大体相同，即每种基团有其特征吸收频率(图4-1，表4-1)。因此，这些基团振动模式和频率可决定矿物红外光谱的主要轮廓，是各种矿物红外光谱的主要特征。也就是说，矿物的红外光谱主要显示一定晶体场中络阴离子团的振动。基团除有内振动外，还有外振动(或晶格振动)，包括晶格中基团的转动以及结构单元之间的相对平动。它们的频率较低，一般位于400cm
equation_inline
^{-1}
text
以下。含络阴离子的矿物是矿物红外光谱的主要研究对象。

吸收带来源于—CH₂一的振动。在结晶聚乙烯的光谱中，720cm⁻¹(13.88μm)吸收带分裂成两个尖锐的吸收带。将结晶聚乙烯加热熔融或在溶液中测定光谱时，由于结晶形转变为无定形。720cm⁻¹双吸收带变为单一的弱宽吸收带。 text

equation_inline

equation_inline
A_{a}B_{b}\cdots X_{n}
text

equation_inline

text
，其中A、B、…为阳离子，X为阴离子(最常见为氧)。A、B、…与X的键强度是不同的，大致可以分为以下两种情况： text
第一种情况 大多数矿物，如碳酸盐、硫酸盐、磷酸盐、硅酸盐及硼酸盐等，其中B—X键比A—X…键强得多，也就是说，晶体结构中可以分出络阴离子或“封闭”的基团
equation_inline
[BX_{n}]
text

text

equation_inline

text

equation_inline
PO_{4}^{3-}
text

equation_inline
SiO_{4}^{3-}
text
及
equation_inline
BO_{3}^{3-}
text

equation_inline
^{-1}

以下。含络阴离子的矿物是矿物红外光谱的主要研究对象。 text
氢氧化物及含水矿物中，OH及

equation_inline
^{-1}
text

3.4.2 烯烃的特征吸收频率 text
烯烃化合物具有3个特征吸收，即双键碳原子上的C—H键伸缩振动、C=C键的伸缩振动和双键碳原子的C—H键的面外弯曲振动。根据这些吸收峰可以容易地将烷烃和烯烃区别开来。 text
① 烯烃=C—H 伸缩振动 烯烃=CH₂ 伸缩振动有对称和不对称之分，除了它的对称伸缩振动吸收出现在 2975cm⁻¹ 处以及饱和烃的甲基不对称伸缩振动吸收重叠之外，其余的烯烃=C—H 伸缩振动皆大于 3000cm⁻¹。由于烷烃的甲基、亚甲基的 C—H 伸缩振动皆小于 3000cm⁻¹，因此，如有不饱和的双键（包括苯环和三元环的 C—H），则多在甲基、亚甲基伸缩振动吸收峰旁边（靠近高波数）出现一个小峰。这是识别不饱和化合物的一个有效特征吸收。

① 烯烃=C—H 伸缩振动 烯烃=CH₂ 伸缩振动有对称和不对称之分，除了它的对称伸缩振动吸收出现在 2975cm⁻¹ 处以及饱和烃的甲基不对称伸缩振动吸收重叠之外，其余的烯烃=C—H 伸缩振动皆大于 3000cm⁻¹。由于烷烃的甲基、亚甲基的 C—H 伸缩振动皆小于 3000cm⁻¹，因此，如有不饱和的双键（包括苯环和三元环的 C—H），则多在甲基、亚甲基伸缩振动吸收峰旁边（靠近高波数）出现一个小峰。这是识别不饱和化合物的一个有效特征吸收。 text
② 烯烃 C=C 伸缩振动 C=C 的伸缩振动对鉴定双键的存在，其作用是有限的，吸收一般位于
equation_inline
1680 \sim 1580 cm^{-1}
text
区域，峰的强度变化较大。当 C=C 键处于分子的对称中心时，此吸收峰完全不出现，而 C=C 键处于不对称中心时，其吸收强度通常也很弱。只有 C=C 与苯环或羰基等共轭时，此吸收峰才成为强吸收，并且吸收频率往低波数方向位移。

太阳光谱及气体成分总含量的测量是以太阳作为光源，而水平或倾斜光路的测量用的是人造光源，如碳弧灯，能斯特灯及激光光源。其它设备是相似的。在野外测试中，光源-接收系统有着相当大的困难，会出现可能的误差，因而定标工作就很重要。

三、高聚物红外光谱的分类 text
如果在分子中含有一些极性较强的基团，则对应这些基团的一些谱带(主要是伸缩振动的基频)在这个化合物的红外光谱中往往是最强的，很明显地显示出这个基团的结构特征。对于各种高聚物的分子来说，含有的主要极性基团是酯、酸、酰胺、酰亚胺、苯醚、脂肪醚和醇等。此外含有硅、硫、磷、氯和氟等原子的化合物也常常具有较强的极性。因此对应这些基团的谱带在其高聚物的谱图中常常是处于最显著的地位，能够很特征地反映这种高聚物的结构和预示这类高聚物的存在。

二、聚丙烯 text
(一) 聚丙烯 text
聚丙烯是塑料工业中发展最快的品种之一，就其产量而言，仅次于聚乙烯、聚氯乙烯和聚苯乙烯居第四位。 text
聚丙烯的结构随使用的催化剂不同而不同。由酸特别是磷酸和Fridel—Craft催化剂制备的聚丙烯是低分子量的油状或橡胶状物质。它是一种含有各种异构体的无规混合物（图4.12）。除作为铺路沥青的添加剂外，用途较少。采用Ziegler—Natta催化剂，除产生高含量的等规聚丙烯外，尚有少量无规聚合物。在己烷中不溶的工业等规聚丙烯是具有全d或全l构型的头尾相接的聚合物。它是高度结晶的，其密度为0.90—0.91，熔点170°C。其制品可以超过100°C使用，具有很高的强度和刚性，可用于注射、挤出或吹塑成型。作为纤维用的聚丙烯，除含等规结构外，还有间规结构。

(一) 聚丙烯 text
聚丙烯是塑料工业中发展最快的品种之一，就其产量而言，仅次于聚乙烯、聚氯乙烯和聚苯乙烯居第四位。 text
聚丙烯的结构随使用的催化剂不同而不同。由酸特别是磷酸和Fridel—Craft催化剂制备的聚丙烯是低分子量的油状或橡胶状物质。它是一种含有各种异构体的无规混合物（图4.12）。除作为铺路沥青的添加剂外，用途较少。采用Ziegler—Natta催化剂，除产生高含量的等规聚丙烯外，尚有少量无规聚合物。在己烷中不溶的工业等规聚丙烯是具有全d或全l构型的头尾相接的聚合物。它是高度结晶的，其密度为0.90—0.91，熔点170°C。其制品可以超过100°C使用，具有很高的强度和刚性，可用于注射、挤出或吹塑成型。作为纤维用的聚丙烯，除含等规结构外，还有间规结构。 text

Fermi 共振是倍频或合频与基频之间的相互作用，又称二级偶合。只有当相互作用的两个键在分子中相互靠近，且倍频或合频与基频也相近时，这种偶合作用才能发生。Fermi 共振的结果使倍频或合频强度增加（基频强度被倍频或合频共享）或发生分裂。
equation_inline
CO_{2}
text

equation_inline
1340cm^{-1}
text
基频与
equation_inline
667cm^{-1}
text
的变角振动的倍频相互作用，产生分裂的两个强谱带（图 16-2）。 text

（三）聚丙烯共混物 text
通常可以用共混的办法来改善聚丙烯的某些性能。如聚丙烯与聚乙烯、乙烯丙烯共聚物、聚异丁烯或聚丁二烯共混改善低温脆性和抗冲击性能。与聚酰胺共混不仅能增加韧性而且能增加耐磨性和耐热性等。与聚乙烯醋酸乙烯酯共混，改善应力开裂、抗冲击和印刷性能等。可以预期在这些共混物的红外光谱中，很易看到聚丙烯螺旋状结构的吸收带和共混聚合物的光谱特征，当读者遇到这些共混物时，可参阅参考文献

record.caption_or_context:
text
三、聚丁烯 text
（三）聚丙烯共混物 text
通常可以用共混的办法来改善聚丙烯的某些性能。如聚丙烯与聚乙烯、乙烯丙烯共聚物、聚异丁烯或聚丁二烯共混改善低温脆性和抗冲击性能。与聚酰胺共混不仅能增加韧性而且能增加耐磨性和耐热性等。与聚乙烯醋酸乙烯酯共混，改善应力开裂、抗冲击和印刷性能等。可以预期在这些共混物的红外光谱中，很易看到聚丙烯螺旋状结构的吸收带和共混聚合物的光谱特征，当读者遇到这些共混物时，可参阅参考文献
equation_inline
^{①}
text
中的有关光谱。 text
三、聚丁烯 text
(一) 聚异丁烯 text
异丁烯能够用阳离子催化剂聚合生成单体单元头尾相接的聚合物，用强酸（硫酸或磷酸）形成齐聚物；用三氯化铝形成低分子量的聚合物（强韧的粘稠产物）；用三氟化硼和辅助催化剂可形成很高分子量的橡胶状产物。聚异丁烯分子间相互作用较弱，仅能形成微弱结晶，可溶于芳香族和脂肪族碳氢化合物中，广泛用作为增塑剂、介电材料、粘合剂和合成橡胶。

simple_table text 由于氢原子的质量轻，当双键上的氢原子较多时，C=C伸缩振动受到的阻力小，力常数小，因此振动频率较低。随着取代基数目增加，C=C伸缩振动受到的阻力增大，增加了有效力常数，C=C伸缩振动移向高频。末端亚乙烯基的双键振动时偶极矩变化大于其他类型的双键，故其吸收带最强。随着双键两侧对称性增加，吸收强度变弱，如对称的反式取代化合物，双键跨越对称中心，根本看不到双键伸缩振动吸收带的存在。因此，如果在1680-1630cm equation_inline ^{-1} text 区域有一中等或强的尖锐吸收带，可以认为双键存在。但是如果在光谱的上述区域看不到吸收带，并不能肯定双键不存在。此外，双键伸缩振动吸收带强度也可作为双键取代情况的佐证。 text 很多因素影响 equation_inline \nu\ (C=C) text 频率

通常可以用共混的办法来改善聚丙烯的某些性能。如聚丙烯与聚乙烯、乙烯丙烯共聚物、聚异丁烯或聚丁二烯共混改善低温脆性和抗冲击性能。与聚酰胺共混不仅能增加韧性而且能增加耐磨性和耐热性等。与聚乙烯醋酸乙烯酯共混，改善应力开裂、抗冲击和印刷性能等。可以预期在这些共混物的红外光谱中，很易看到聚丙烯螺旋状结构的吸收带和共混聚合物的光谱特征，当读者遇到这些共混物时，可参阅参考文献

(一) 聚异丁烯 text
异丁烯能够用阳离子催化剂聚合生成单体单元头尾相接的聚合物，用强酸（硫酸或磷酸）形成齐聚物；用三氯化铝形成低分子量的聚合物（强韧的粘稠产物）；用三氟化硼和辅助催化剂可形成很高分子量的橡胶状产物。聚异丁烯分子间相互作用较弱，仅能形成微弱结晶，可溶于芳香族和脂肪族碳氢化合物中，广泛用作为增塑剂、介电材料、粘合剂和合成橡胶。 text

(一) 聚异丁烯 text

（三）混纺比例的测定 text
纱线和织物混纺比例是工厂生产控制或实验室进行工艺研究中经常遇到的问题。测定方法包括化学分析、密度法、回潮法、差热法、红外光谱法等。用红外光谱法测定，取样量少，简便快速，相对误差在±2—4%。 text
混纺比的测定可用 KBr 压片法，也可用衰减全反射法。测定方法一般是先将纯的纤维样品按各种不同比例，配制成标准样品，制成 KBr 压片，或 ATR 试样。绘制其红外光谱。选择对浓度变化敏感的谱带为分析谱带，对浓度变化不敏感的谱带为参考谱带。通过实验选择合适的基线。使测得的分析谱带的吸光度与某一成分的浓度有线性关系。由标准样品测试结果绘出。吸光度（或吸光度比）～成分。或峰面积～成分的工作曲线。按同法对未知样品测定，由工作曲线上求得某一成分的含量。

（1）溶剂萃取法 选取适当的溶剂，可将某些整理剂萃取下来。用分步萃取法，依次用己烷、1,1,1-三氯乙烷、甲醇、水，可将大多数整理剂从纤维上分别萃取下来，然后鉴定。对于在纤维上发生交联的树脂整理剂，可用稀盐酸水解萃取。选择溶剂时考虑了它们的极性、溶解性、挥发性，安全性。根据这个原则，对某个具体的研究对象，也可选用其它溶剂，如三氯乙烯、丙酮、过氯乙烯等。 text

3. 在观察光谱时应注意区别羟基和胺基，在非极性溶剂的稀溶液中测定光谱，虽然两者的吸收带都比较尖锐，但羟基吸收通常高于
equation_inline
3600 \, cm^{-1}
text
，而胺基则在
equation_inline
3500 \, cm^{-1}
text
以下。氢键缔合的羟基和胺基伸缩振动频率几乎出现在相同的区域，但前者峰比较宽，后者形状比较尖锐。 text
4. 鉴别胺基的另一个比较好的方法是用盐酸处理样品，如果是胺类化合物，胺基的
equation_inline
\nu(\mathrm{NH}_{2})
text
或
equation_inline
\nu(\mathrm{NH})
text
特征吸收带消失，而在
equation_inline
3000-2000cm^{-1}
text
区域出现铵盐的特征吸收（见第九节）。 text
第九节 铵 盐 text
当胺类化合物用酸（通常用盐酸）处理后生成铵盐，其相应的红外光谱发生明显的变化。胺的吸收带比较宽，而铵盐的吸收带尖锐，图形更为特征。根据铵盐的光谱来鉴别胺类就更容易，且由
equation_inline
3000-2000cm^{-1}
text
区域的吸收还可区别铵盐的类型。 text
伯铵盐的
equation_inline
NH_{3}^{+}
text
伸缩振动频率在
equation_inline
\sim3000cm^{-1}
text
，它是一个宽强吸收带或多重峰，与 C-H 伸缩振动频率重叠。多数伯铵盐在
equation_inline
\sim2500
text
和
equation_inline
2200-1800cm^{-1}
text
还有特征的吸收，而大多数仲铵盐和叔铵盐是没有的。仲铵盐和叔铵盐在
equation_inline
2700-2250cm^{-1}
text
也有类似于伯铵盐的宽强吸收或一组尖锐的吸收带。仲铵盐吸收带与 C-H 伸缩振动吸收带虽有些分开，但多少还有些重叠。叔铵盐吸收带在
equation_inline
2500cm^{-1}
text
附近能与 C-H 伸缩振动吸收带分得很开。铵盐的
equation_inline
NH^{+}
text
变角振动频率在
equation_inline
1600-1575cm^{-1}
text
。亚铵盐
equation_inline
(C=NH^{+})
text
是易于鉴别的，因为除了
equation_inline
2500-2300cm^{-1}
text
叔铵盐的
equation_inline
N-H^{+}
text
伸缩振动吸收外，在
equation_inline
2000cm^{-1}
text
还有一个亚铵盐的吸收带，借此可与其他铵盐相区别，亚胺成盐后，C=N 伸缩振动向高频位移至

1680cm^{-1}
text

text 当胺类化合物用酸（通常用盐酸）处理后生成铵盐，其相应的红外光谱发生明显的变化。胺的吸收带比较宽，而铵盐的吸收带尖锐，图形更为特征。根据铵盐的光谱来鉴别胺类就更容易，且由 equation_inline 3000-2000cm^{-1} text 区域的吸收还可区别铵盐的类型。 text 4. 鉴别胺基的另一个比较好的方法是用盐酸处理样品，如果是胺类化合物，胺基的 equation_inline \nu(\mathrm{NH}_{2}) text 或 equation_inline \nu(\mathrm{NH}) text 特征吸收带消失，而在 equation_inline 3000-2000cm^{-1} text 区域出现铵盐的特征吸收（见第九节）。 text 第九节 铵 盐 text 当胺类化合物用酸（通常用盐酸）处理后生成铵盐，其相应的红外光谱发生明显的变化。胺的吸收带比较宽，而铵盐的吸收带尖锐，图形更为特征。根据铵盐的光谱来鉴别胺类就更容易，且由 equation_inline 3000-2000cm^{-1} text 区域的吸收还可区别铵盐的类型。 text 伯铵盐的 equation_inline NH_{3}^{+} text 伸缩振动频率在 equation_inline \sim3000cm^{-1} text ，它是一个宽强吸收带或多重峰，与 C-H 伸缩振动频率重叠。多数伯铵盐在 equation_inline \sim2500 text 和 equation_inline 2200-1800cm^{-1} text 还有特征的吸收，而大多数仲铵盐和叔铵盐是没有的。仲铵盐和叔铵盐在 equation_inline 2700-2250cm^{-1} text 也有类似于伯铵盐的宽强吸收或一组尖锐的吸收带。仲铵盐吸收带与 C-H 伸缩振动吸收带虽有些分开，但多少还有些重叠。叔铵盐吸收带在 equation_inline 2500cm^{-1} text 附近能与 C-H 伸缩振动吸收带分得很开。铵盐的 equation_inline NH^{+} text 变角振动频率在 equation_inline 1600-1575cm^{-1} text 。亚铵盐 equation_inline (C=NH^{+}) text 是易于鉴别的，因为除了 equation_inline 2500-2300cm^{-1} text 叔铵盐的 equation_inline N-H^{+} text 伸缩振动吸收外，在 equation_inline 2000cm^{-1} text 还有一个亚铵盐的吸收带，借此可与其他铵盐相区别，亚胺成盐后，C=N 伸缩振动向高频位移至 equation_inline 1680cm^{-1} text 。 text 表 16-13 铵盐的振动频率（KBr 压片数据）

碳酸盐矿物由碳酸根离子
equation_inline
\left(\mathrm{CO}_{3}\right)^{2-}
text
与Ca、Mg、Fe、Mn、Sr、Ba、Zn、Pb、Cu、TR、Na等金属阳离子化合而成。有的矿物还含有附加阴离子(如OH、F、Cl等)及
equation_inline
H_{2}O
text
等。
equation_inline
CO_{3}
text
内部，C—O共价键连接成一稳固的基团。在结构中，
equation_inline
CO_{3}
text
彼此由阳离子以离子键连接。

complex_table text （二）溶剂干扰的比较 text 前面提到水谱带的遮蔽效应是红外光谱技术的一大难题。然而，日用化学品中许多物质，特别是表面活性剂、助剂、乳化剂等都离不开水，只有在水溶液中才能表现出它们的表面活性、增溶性、胶束性、乳化性、泡沫性以及其它性质。如果离开了水，它们的这些性质便会发生变化，甚至会完全失去应有的特性。值得提出的是：近代日用化学品正在向着天然生物的方向发展。而一些生物样品，只有在水溶液或含有大量水的情况下才具有活性，脱水后不仅生物活性发生很大的变化，它们的结构也会产生很大的变化。同时，便会失去它们对肌肤和毛发的滋养和保护使用。因此要研究这些日用化学品的性质和机理，就必须在水溶液中测试。 text 621

区间，它包括 C-O-C 的不对称伸缩振动和对称伸缩振动 2 个峰，其中 C-O-C 不对称伸缩振动为一强而宽展的峰，称为“酯带”，它的强度通常比 C=O 吸收峰还要大，这是鉴定酯类的一个重要依据。相比之下，C-O-C 对称伸缩振动的重要性就远不如它的不对称伸缩振动。因此，在识别酯类时一般只要在

text
区域内找到 1 个非常强而宽的吸收峰就可以了。

韭叶芸香草精油是将新鲜植物(或干草)蒸馏出精油,淡黄色,并具有不愉快的气味。精油用KOH-乙醇溶液加热迴流皂化。皂化产物用水洗至中性,用水汽带馏以除去刺鼻的气味。馏出产物经无水硫酸钠干燥后用Perkin-Elmer251旋带蒸馏塔减压分馏,共收集8个馏分,其中第七、第八馏分为香叶醇,纯度达到97%以上,它具有香叶醇特征的香气,香气优于95%的商品香叶醇。印度产的玫瑰草油中香叶醇含量为75—95%,称之高级香叶醇的来源,具有很高的经济价值。然而,我国云南省的韭叶芸香草的香叶醇和乙酸香叶酯的含量也高达85.75%。该油经过简单的处理可以得到品质优良的香叶醇,所以这个品种有较高的经济价值和应用价值。

(4) 适用样品 液膜法制样最大的优点是简便，摄谱易于成功，但沸点在
equation_inline
100^{\circ}\mathrm{C}
text
以下或挥发性强的样品不适用，一些粘度特别大、无法展开成膜的粘胶类样品也不易获得满意的谱图。此外，毒性大或腐蚀性、吸湿性强的液体也不宜采用这种方法，如要使用则必须注意防护措施，且样品也应尽可能少加，以免操作测试过程中泄漏沾污。遇到这类样品时，建议将样品封入聚乙烯袋中，再夹在二块晶体之间去测谱。聚乙烯膜应很薄，不超过
equation_inline
10\mu \mathrm{m}
text
，袋的面积应比晶面稍大，袋中样品不可多装，形成的样品液膜也同样不应有气泡空隙。如要在所得谱图中去除聚乙烯的吸收，可用同种材料测谱后扣除。 text
液膜制样法适用除上述之外的全部液态样品。 text

实验是将大花素馨浸膏用二氯甲烷为溶剂进行同时蒸馏萃取。得到淡黄色精油，具有强烈的素馨鲜花特征香气。精油未经分离，直接进行 GC/FTIR 联用和 GC/MS 联用分析鉴定，色谱柱用 SE-54 石英毛细管柱，长 30 米。 text
图 14-12 是大花素馨浸膏精油的 GC/MS 总离子流图，共分离出约 50 个组分，鉴定了其中 41 个组分，占精油总量的 98.8%。其中 MS 鉴定了 34 个组分，FTIR 鉴定了 21 个组分。用两种方法同时鉴定 14 个组分。主要成分为反式异丁香酚（28.94%），乙酸苄酯（23.92%），丁香酚（7.20%），棕榈酸甲酯（5.51%），邻苯二甲酯丁基异丁基酯（4.76%），芳樟醇（4.13%），金合欢醇（3.06%），乙酸金合欢酯（3.02%）等。（见表 14-7） text

1987 年 Fuller

text
提出应用傅里叶变换红外光谱实时“在线”质量监控洗涤剂生产过程中表面活性剂的含量。在中红外采用封闭式 ATR 流动液体池、近红外用 1 毫米透射式流动池作为“在线”监控的样品通过的测试器皿。整个监控过程的定量计算是运用偏最小二乘（PLS）定量软件包来完成
equation_inline
^{[16]}
text
。 text
（一）实验方法 text
将封闭式 ATR 流动液体池和 1 毫米透射式流动池分别安装在中红外和近红外 FTIR 光谱仪的样品室。然后，在生产线的监测口引一管线，把被监控的液体洗涤液用微量泵分别泵入上述两个流动池中。因为流动池的出口溶液未受任何破坏，所以可送入原生产线。中红外光束通过 ATR 流动池的 ZnSe 棱镜多次衰减内全反射，带着中红外的光谱信息到达 DTGS 检测器；近红外光束通过透射式流动池，带着近红外的光谱信息到达硅检测器。全部光谱信息和数据输入 PLS 软件包，“在线”监控洗涤剂生产过程中表面活性剂和助剂等多组分的定量分析。 text
样品是由5种添加剂混合加入洗涤剂基质中组成。各成分是按重量百分比计算，其中洗涤剂基质（85—90%），1,2-丙二醇（1.4—4%），聚丙烯乙二醇（0.9—3.6%），丙三醇（1.4—34%），苯甲酸钠（0.3—1.5%），2-丙醇（1—5%）。按此浓度范围配制了21个不同比例的标准样品，备PLS定量软件中校正光谱之用。

正因为这个原因，选择 PLS 定量软件分析光谱数据，非常适用于日用化学品工厂中固定作业中的实时“在线”定量分析。即使遇到像洗涤剂许多同类并结构相似的多组分（如醇类），浓度又要求在一定量的范围（如上面叙述的 6 种组分）内变化，而 PLS 采取全频率的回归分析，完全可以把定量分析精度提高到很理想的水平。 text
在正式作实时“在线”质量监控之前，必须作标准样品的校正。其步骤是：首先将标准样品浓度形成校正矩阵，也就是说各组分的浓度在上述范围内分配均匀并且有足够的数量（本实验的标准样品为21个）；其次将21个标准样品分为校正和标定两组，最后完成标准样品的光谱图，输入已知各组分浓度数据，校正运算并形成校正数据。

一、红外光谱数据库与检索方法的早期发展 text
很显然，一个好的光谱检索系统依赖一个大的、高质量的光谱数据库和一套或数套性能优良的检索方法。几十年来，世界上很多研究机构报告了各种把光谱信息转变为计算机可读形式的方法和在红外光谱鉴定中的某些新思想和新概念。由于红外光谱和质谱、核磁共振及X射线衍射等光谱技术有所不同，除了频率以外，红外吸收光谱在谱带形状方面也具备有特征性的结构信息，这就必然增加了在光谱数字化方面技术上的难度和种种耗费。这些困难不断地被人们克服。近十几年来，傅里叶变换技术的应用与发展，一些高质量的数据库和许多检索算法充分利用了红外光谱独特的峰形和全光谱信息，使这一计算机谱库检索技术愈加成熟。 text
一、红外光谱数据库与检索方法的早期发展 text
早在 1951 年，为了利用计算机代替人工进行自动谱图检索，将光谱的数字化表示形式存放在 IBM 计算机穿孔卡片上的想法就已经提出来了
equation_inline
^{[1,2]}
text
。早期是利用机械的挑选装置对穿孔卡片上的数据进行检索。对于不断增大的谱图数量来说，这种方法是太慢了，但是这种光谱编码的方式是当时的一种通用方式。这种编码方式是将记录的光谱以波长为单位，每 0.1 微米划分为一个区间，如果有吸收峰最大值出现在某个区间内，就记作二进制数码 “1”，如没有就记作 “0”，这样，一 text

二甲硅酮对冲洗后皮肤的附着力测试的位置，是前臂10厘米长方形中的2.5厘米的皮肤。此部位用肥皂洗净、冲洗好并轻轻用餐巾拍干，前臂放在水平ATR的ZnSe棱镜上扫描收集FTIR光谱。然后用注射器吸入100微升的护肤液涂抹在前臂的洗净位置，用不同的护肤液涂抹在另一只前臂上。将手套入聚乙塑料罩中，放置50分钟，待皮肤水分含量增加。这样当皮肤与水平ATR棱镜接触时，其光谱的吸光度会有很大的提高。如果没有这一步骤，光谱的吸收强度则非常弱。移去塑料罩，将前臂置于水平ATR棱镜之上，扫描收集FTIR光谱。再用水冲洗15秒钟，轻轻用餐巾纸拍干，再次将手放入塑料罩中50分钟，取出在水平ATR棱镜上扫描收集光谱。 text

PAIRS 软件包括三个主要部分，即解释规则、规则编译器和解释程序。它的一个成功之处是把解释规则和解释程序完全分开。解释规则在这个软件中是作为数据处理的，这样一来，修改规则就不需要有专门的编程技术，一个有经验的光谱学家可以随时更新、修改 PAIRS 中的解释规则，而他不必是一个计算机软件专家。这种分离已经成为以语言为基础的软件系统的一个基本原则，成功地应用于其他计算机在化学中的应用里。 text
PAIRS 解释规则是用一种类似于英语的 CONCISE 语言（Computer Oriented Notation Concerning Infrared Spectra Evaluation）编写的，它是按分级判别树的结构建立的，并由带有 BEGIN-DONE 块的 IF-THEN-ELSE 逻辑块组成。CONCISE 只有很少的词汇量（62 个单词），使光谱学家很容易掌握。图 17-13 是芳香类分级判别树的片段。规则编译程序是用 FORTRAN 语言编写的，它可以检查所写规则在语法方面的错误，并能对之进行压缩。解释程序也是一个 FORTRAN text

某一化合物中含有砜基，可能性数值为0.850，而操作人员对这一可能性有疑问，PAIRS程序的改进版本可以提供一个跟踪解释，说明赋予砜基这样高的可能性数值的理由，这就为确切判断提供了依据。Saperstein提出了一个评价和优化解释结果的方法[28]。在进行了光谱解释之后，首先从被鉴定出来的官能团基团频率计算出来一个合成光谱，通过目测或是数学方法，将这个合成光谱和原始未知物光谱进行比较，就能初步确定上述解释的可靠程序。然后，再对未知物光谱和由各官能团的特征子谱带合成的人工组合谱之间的差异进行估计，同时对每一个官能团的可能性数值进行修改，使得上述谱图差异的估价数值趋向最小值，经过若干次这样的优化循环之后，可以使解释的结果得到很大的改善。

一、在核化学化工研究中的应用 text
核事业中，由于某种程度的疏漏和差错而引起不正常现象，有时伴随一些材料发生结构改变，为了及时查清事故起因或及时排除故障，利用红外光谱手段进行观测也会有所帮助，例如核动力装置中水质净化系统的离子变换树脂泄漏，在一回路高温高压水中会发生分解，对一些部位取样，用红外光谱可以观测到树脂分解产物，由此便可得知离子变换树脂是否发生了泄漏。原则上讲，红外光谱在核事故分析中的用途可能相当广泛，核行业工种类别多，性质也千差万别，这里不赘述。 text

（二）钢系元素及其配合物化学 text
a. 钢系元素萃取机理和萃合物结构 text
核化学与放射化学的研究对象一般来说是微量的且往往是瞬变的，研究过程中对一些快速、灵敏的观察工具和手段的需求是显而易见的。FTIR光谱仪测谱快速、灵敏、重现性和分辨率高、测量范围宽，用于核化学和放射化学研究是十分有利的。通过测量红外光谱来表征铀、钍、钚等锕系元素配合物结构，对于研究萃取等分离方法的化学机理和改进分离方法是很重要的。 text
锕系及镧系元素β-二酮配合物的研究在核燃料的分离和分析应用方面以及在探讨阐释络合萃取机理等基础研究方面均有重要意义。在与各种中性萃取剂协同萃取锕系元素方面，β-二酮类是较好的螯合萃取剂。刘伟生等
equation_inline
^{[28]}

text 锕系及镧系元素β-二酮配合物的研究在核燃料的分离和分析应用方面以及在探讨阐释络合萃取机理等基础研究方面均有重要意义。在与各种中性萃取剂协同萃取锕系元素方面，β-二酮类是较好的螯合萃取剂。刘伟生等 equation_inline ^{[28]} text 对邻菲啰啉单氮氧化物（phen NO）与硝酸钍形成固态配合物及首次合成的Phen NO和乙酰丙酮（Hacac）与铀酰的三元配合物进行了研究 equation_inline ^{[29]} text 。使用Nicolet 170SX傅里叶变换红外光谱，KBr压片，在4000—200cm equation_inline ^{-1} text 范围内摄谱。与配体phen NO比较，钍配合物的红外光谱中有关Phen NO的某些特征振动吸收峰发生了位移，N→O键伸缩振动和弯曲振动分别发生红移和紫移，环的伸缩振动和碳氢面外弯曲振动也发生了不同程度的位移，这是由于phen NO分子吡啶N原子及氧化吡啶N→O基的氧原子向金属离子配位引起的。在远红外区出现了相应Th→O（phen NO）的新吸收峰（338cm equation_inline ^{-1} text ），进一步证明了phen NO与钍离子配位。红外光谱也给出了配合物中同时存在游离型硝酸根及配位型硝酸根的信息。在1800—1700cm equation_inline ^{-1} text 区域内出现1766cm equation_inline ^{-1} text ，1735cm equation_inline ^{-1} text ，1720cm equation_inline ^{-1} text 3个峰表明两种硝酸根同时存在，配位硝酸根两吸收峰分裂值31cm equation_inline ^{-1} text ，说明其配位形式为二齿配位。3403cm equation_inline ^{-1} text 处是羟基伸缩吸收峰，说明配合物中含水。表15-2列出了phen NO，UO equation_inline _{2} text (acac) equation_inline _{2} text 铀酰三元配合物的红外光谱与二元配合物 equation_inline \mathrm{UO}_2 text (acac)。 equation_inline 2\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O} text 比较，有关acac的吸收变化不大， equation_inline \nu_{\mathrm{C=O}} text 的吸收位置基本相同，表明两种配合物中acac具有类似的配位结构，即acac以双齿形式与中心离子配位。形成三元配合物后，phen NO分子的 equation_inline \mathrm{N} \rightarrow \mathrm{O} text 键伸缩振动 equation_inline \nu_{\mathrm{N-O}} text 为 equation_inline 1251\mathrm{cm}^{-1} text 向低波数方向位移了 equation_inline 17\mathrm{cm}^{-1} text ，这是由于配体中氧原子与中心离子配位后， equation_inline \mathrm{N} \rightarrow \mathrm{O} text 键的 equation_inline \pi text 键成分降低，导致 equation_inline \mathrm{N} \rightarrow \mathrm{O} text 键力常数减小，使 equation_inline \nu_{\mathrm{N-O}} text 向低波数移动。 equation_inline \mathrm{O}-\mathrm{U}-\mathrm{O} text 反对称伸缩振动的强吸收峰在 equation_inline 905\mathrm{cm}^{-1} text 处出现，相应振动频率在 equation_inline \mathrm{UO}_2 text (acac)。 equation_inline 2\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O} text 及水溶液中 equation_inline \mathrm{UO}_2^{2+} text 离子分别为 equation_inline 910\mathrm{cm}^{-1} text 和 equation_inline 965\mathrm{cm}^{-1} text ，这种差别可能与配体场的强度有关。 equation_inline 3414\mathrm{cm}^{-1} text 处吸收峰表明配合物有水。施鼐等[30]制备了分子式为 equation_inline \mathrm{UO}_2\mathrm{A}_2 text 。HA的四种铀酰β-二酮配合物，式中HA代表乙酰丙酮（HAA），苯甲酰丙酮（HBA），二苯甲酰甲烷（HDBM）及2-噻吩甲酰三氟丙酮（HTTA）等四种β-二酮配体，A为相应β-二酮阴离子，并在 equation_inline 4000 - 150\mathrm{cm}^{-1} text 范围内研究了它们的红外光谱。中红外光谱的测定是将固体样品加石蜡油研磨成糊状，涂抹在溴化钾晶片上，在Perkin-Elmer 683型红外分光光度计上测谱，远红外谱是将固体样品加碘化铯作稀释剂，研细压成薄片，在Nicolet 7199B傅里叶变换红外光谱仪上测定。图15-5和图15-6分别示出 equation_inline \mathrm{UO}_2(\mathrm{DBM})_2\cdot \mathrm{HDBM} text 的中红外谱和傅里叶变换远红外谱。表19-3列出各配合物的一些特征吸收带及其近似指认，同时也列出了相应β-二酮的羰基和 equation_inline \mathrm{C = C} text 吸收峰以便于对比。 text 锕系及镧系元素β-二酮配合物的研究在核燃料的分离和分析应用方面以及在探讨阐释络合萃取机理等基础研究方面均有重要意义。在与各种中性萃取剂协同萃取锕系元素方面，β-二酮类是较好的螯合萃取剂。刘伟生等 equation_inline ^{[28]} text 对邻菲啰啉单氮氧化物（phen NO）与硝酸钍形成固态配合物及首次合成的Phen NO和乙酰丙酮（Hacac）与铀酰的三元配合物进行了研究 equation_inline ^{[29]} text 。使用Nicolet 170SX傅里叶变换红外光谱，KBr压片，在4000—200cm equation_inline ^{-1} text 范围内摄谱。与配体phen NO比较，钍配合物的红外光谱中有关Phen NO的某些特征振动吸收峰发生了位移，N→O键伸缩振动和弯曲振动分别发生红移和紫移，环的伸缩振动和碳氢面外弯曲振动也发生了不同程度的位移，这是由于phen NO分子吡啶N原子及氧化吡啶N→O基的氧原子向金属离子配位引起的。在远红外区出现了相应Th→O（phen NO）的新吸收峰（338cm equation_inline ^{-1} text ），进一步证明了phen NO与钍离子配位。红外光谱也给出了配合物中同时存在游离型硝酸根及配位型硝酸根的信息。在1800—1700cm equation_inline ^{-1} text 区域内出现1766cm equation_inline ^{-1} text ，1735cm equation_inline ^{-1} text ，1720cm equation_inline ^{-1} text 3个峰表明两种硝酸根同时存在，配位硝酸根两吸收峰分裂值31cm equation_inline ^{-1} text ，说明其配位形式为二齿配位。3403cm equation_inline ^{-1} text 处是羟基伸缩吸收峰，说明配合物中含水。表15-2列出了phen NO，UO equation_inline _{2} text (acac) equation_inline _{2} text ·2H equation_inline _{2} text O及UO equation_inline _{2} text (phen NO)(acac) equation_inline _{2} text ·H equation_inline _{2} text O的红外光谱中一些主要的特征振动吸收频率。 text 表 15-2 红外光谱数据 ( equation_inline cm^{-1} text )

text
二、聚异戊二烯 text
5.丁二烯的其它共聚物 text
丁二烯苯乙烯共聚物、丁二烯丙烯腈共聚物和丁二烯甲基丙烯酸甲酯共聚物都可以用羧酸（甲基丙烯酸、丙烯酸或马来酸）进行改性。在改性后的三元共聚物的光谱中可观察到
equation_inline
1690cm^{-1}(5.92\mu m)
text
的羧基吸收带，不过该吸收带弱，易与氧化产生的谱带混洽。有时马来酸易形成酸酐，在1818和
equation_inline
1770cm^{-1}(5.5和5.65\mu m)
text
还会产生吸收。由于这些共聚物红外光谱是其组成的单体单元特征光谱的叠加，故用红外光谱分析方法不难推断其组成。 text
二、聚异戊二烯 text
聚异戊二烯是一种近似天然橡胶结构的弹性体，1959年美国用Zeigler催化剂合成了这种聚烯烃橡胶。 text
2-甲基丁二烯-1.3聚合产生四种不同的结构单元。

complex_table text 图 15-8 配体及配合物的红外光谱 text a. 配体 b. 配合物 text 图中○处为石蜡油峰 text 从表 15-7 可以看出，形成配合物后，配体的特征振动频率 equation_inline \nu_{\mathrm{Ar-O-R}} text 及 equation_inline \nu_{\mathrm{R-O-R}} text 分别向低波数方向位移了 equation_inline 5--30\mathrm{cm}^{-1} text 和 equation_inline 2--30\mathrm{cm}^{-1} text 。这是由于铀酰离子的配位作用使醚氧原子上的电子云密度降低，C-O 键极性减小造成的。配合物在 equation_inline 220\mathrm{cm}^{-1} text 处出现 U-O 振动的弱吸收， equation_inline 942\mathrm{cm}^{-1} text 及 equation_inline 225\mathrm{cm}^{-1} text 处出现铀酰的伸缩及弯曲振动吸收峰。红外光谱也证实所有硝酸根都参与配位，配合物含水而不含乙腈。王文基等[55]研究了数种冠醚的 1,2-二氯乙烷溶液从硝酸、盐酸和苦味酸等水溶液中萃取钍的行为及其萃合物的红外光谱，是将萃取硝酸钍的有机相、纯冠醚有机溶液以及硝酸钍水溶液均匀涂布在压缩聚乙烯片或镀金镜片上，经真空干燥去除溶剂。涂布在压缩聚乙烯片上的样品采用透射吸收法测定远红外光谱，涂布在镀金片上的样品用于测定中红外或远红外光谱。红外光透过样品在镜片上反射，再次透过样品，然后进入检测系统，即二次透射法，它具有灵敏度、本底干扰小和制样方便等优点。涂布样品在去除溶剂之后得到的红外光谱实际上是萃合物与游离冠醚两组分混合物的光谱。为了得到纯萃合物的光谱，采用了吸光度减法处理。在红外光谱上，数据系统通过减谱程序可实现吸光度自动差减的操作，能得到差示光谱。图 15-9 给出了其差光谱。在远红外范围，由有机相混合物的光谱与纯硝酸钍光谱经上述吸光度减法处理得到差示光谱。纯冠醚在所测的远红外区域并无特征吸收峰存在，所以不予考虑。而硝酸钍本身在该区域却有明显的特征吸收，在吸光度减法处理中则是不可忽视的。图 15-10 是远红外范围的差示光谱。

1112 - 1128\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text

equation_inline
30\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text

equation_inline
\mathrm{Th(NO_3)_4 - DC18C6}

text
两种体系的萃合物远红外光谱，在减法

天然橡胶是异戊二烯的聚合物，不过通常工业上所指的天然橡胶是由希维亚橡胶树（巴西橡胶树）中取得的。它是较纯的顺式1.4-聚异戊二烯，在常温下具有弹性，且为无定形，这种橡胶具有很大的国民经济价值。相反，马来橡胶（古塔波胶）和巴拉塔橡胶是由反式1.4-聚异戊二烯组成的，这种橡胶在常温下质硬、弹性差、用途较窄。此外，在中美洲的糖胶树中还有一种天然的聚异戊二烯是由四分之三反式1.4-和四分之一顺式1.4-结构组成的。所有天然橡胶皆含有树脂状化合物和蛋白质，因此在测定它们的光谱前要纯化样品。 text

碳氢化合物，使用Digilab FTS 15/80 和 20/80 型傅里叶变换红外光谱仪利用差示谱测定同位素物种，以研究 Li/Mgo 高温催化甲烷氧化反应的机理。它可以补充质谱测试同位素物种方面某些不足之处。以 D 标记为例，实验以
equation_inline
\mathrm{CD_4}
text
测定甲烷转化反应的速率控制步骤并研究
equation_inline
\mathrm{C_2}
text
碳氢化物产生机理。分析工作主要是测定所产生的乙烷和乙烯。图 15-25 给出了
equation_inline
2200\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text
至
equation_inline
2050\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text
范围内的 3 个谱图，图 15-25，a 谱是进料
equation_inline
\mathrm{CD_4 / O_2 / He}
text
混合物通过 Li/MgO 催化床在
equation_inline
750^{\circ}\mathrm{C}
text
的产品气的谱图，在
equation_inline
2200 - 2150\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text
之间的一些谱线是
equation_inline
\mathrm{CD_4}
text
的。图 15-25，b 谱是由 a 谱减去料气谱得到的谱图，这一步有效地扣除了
equation_inline
\mathrm{CD_4}
text
的谱线而显露出 CO 谱线，实验中可以检测出 CO 浓度为
equation_inline
0.04\% (\mathrm{v} / \mathrm{v})
text
。图 15-25，c 谱是由
equation_inline
\mathrm{CH_4 / O_2 / He}
text
混合物减去产品气以扣除 CO 谱线，谱线
equation_inline
2087.2\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text
同相关的精细结构一起显露出来，这被指认为
equation_inline
\mathrm{C_2D_6}
text
，其谱图结构是费米共振显著吸收组合频率带，实验中检测到
equation_inline
\mathrm{C_2D_6}
text
浓度是
equation_inline
0.08\% (\mathrm{v} / \mathrm{v})
text
，因此，可以以高的信噪比测检比反应物（
equation_inline
\mathrm{CD_4}
text
，
equation_inline
9.3\% \mathrm{v} / \mathrm{v}
text
）浓度低得多的标记产物。在另一些实验中，通过类似的方法和步骤，在用
equation_inline
\mathrm{CH_4 / CD_4}
text
混合物中显露出
equation_inline
\mathrm{CH_3CD_3}
text
的信息。这对质谱来说是困难的，一方面是因为质谱检测过程中有大量甲烷碎片干扰，另一方面质谱无法将
equation_inline
\mathrm{CH_3CD_3}
text
和各同分异构物
equation_inline
\mathrm{C_2H_3D_3}
text
加以区分。因此说红外差示谱在研究催化反应机理用同位素标记时，对质谱测量产物分布和同分异构鉴别也是一个强有力的补充技术。

漫反射法成为一种光谱测试技术最早可追溯到30年代，但以前多用于测定固体粉末和混浊液的紫外-可见光谱，用于红外光谱测定则是在傅里叶变换红外光谱仪出现之后。1976年Willey
equation_inline
^{[13]}
text
在傅里叶变换红外光谱仪上用该法成功地获得了高质量的固体样品红外光谱，此后Fuller等
equation_inline
^{[14]}
text
和董庆年等
equation_inline
^{[15]}
text
对漫反射光谱的测试条件都进行过详细研究。漫反射法可以直接测定粉末样品的红外光谱，它的测试原理很简单：当入射光照射在粉末样品上时，除了一部分光被表层反射外，其余部分将刺入疏松样品的内部进行反射、折射、散射和吸收。当这部分光再次穿出样品表面，就成为被样品吸收所衰减了的反射光，因此由探测器所测得的各波数光的强度就不一样。当它与相同条件下测得的碱金属卤化物（如KBr或KCl）粉末的漫反射光谱相比，就能得到一个类似于通常透射光谱的反射光谱，图2-4就是用该法测得的甲基化黄腐酸粉末和风化煤腐植酸粉末的漫反射光谱
equation_inline
^{[15]}
text
，为便于比较，图中也列出了用KBr压片法测得的透射光谱。由图可见，用这两种方法获得的光谱非常相似。 text

equation_inline

text
区的红外光谱图，但对煤样粒度要求严格 (
equation_inline
<2\mu m
text

，为便于比较，图中也列出了用KBr压片法测得的透射光谱。由图可见，用这两种方法获得的光谱非常相似。 text
漫反射光谱法特别适用于煤反应的研究中。在这种情况下，漫反射附件往往设计成既是样品槽又是反应器，因此可以原位（insitu）观察反应过程。图2-5是漫反射技术用于煤羟基氘代反应的例子

^{[16]}

equation_inline
D_{2}O
text
交换后，
equation_inline
\sim3400cm^{-1}
text
区的羟基吸收带强度显著降低，并在
equation_inline
\sim2600cm^{-1}
text
区出现由OD所引起的宽带，而氘化煤暴露于空气后，谱图又基本复原，反映氘代作用的可逆性。谱图系原位测定，因此该例也显示了漫反射光谱法用于煤反应动力学研究的可能性。 text

text
筛选了 200 余种化合物，认为 2, 2-二氯-1, 1, 1-三氟乙烷（
equation_inline
CF_{3}CHCl_{2}
text
，商名为氟利昂-123）是用红外多光子解离进行激光分离氘的最有前途的化合物之一。在实验中，已获得了极高的富集因子，而能否推广到工业生产中去的一个关键问题是该化合物的再氘化过程。为此，穆国融等
equation_inline
^{[128]}
text
对
equation_inline
CF_{3}CHCl_{2}
text
的 H/D 同位素交换反应动力学作了研究。为保证实验精度，不使用含有大量同分异构体的商品氟利昂-123，均自行制备并仔细纯化，其红外光谱图与文献所报道的谱图一致，证明产物的纯度优良。以
equation_inline
0.4\mathrm{mol} / 1\mathrm{NaOD}
text
为催化剂，用纯
equation_inline
\mathrm{CF_3CHCl_3}
text
与
equation_inline
99.93\% \mathrm{D}_2\mathrm{O}
text
在恒温条件下震荡平衡后去除水相，重新更换新鲜的
equation_inline
\mathrm{D}_2\mathrm{O} + \mathrm{NaOD}3
text
次以上得浓度
equation_inline
98\%
text
以上的
equation_inline
\mathrm{CF_3CDCl_2}
text
，其红外光谱图与文献所报道的吻合。实验中使用IFS-113型傅里叶变换红外光谱仪测定氟利昂-123浓度变化。用计算机把透射率坐标换成吸光度坐标，以化合物的红外特征峰高与压力作图得一直线，由此得出峰高与压力成正比的关系。在氘化过程中，取出一定压力的
equation_inline
\mathrm{CF_3CHCl_2}
text
和
equation_inline
\mathrm{CF_3CDCl_2}
text
的特征峰高来计算其转化百分数，从而可以进一步对氘化池中
equation_inline
\mathrm{CF_3CHCl_2}
text
的浓度依次定量。动力学实验研究中即根据此法以
equation_inline
841\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text
峰高的减少来计算一d（
equation_inline
\mathrm{CF_3CHCl_2}
text
）/dt。为了了解氟利昂-123和其同分异构体氟利昂-123a（
equation_inline
\mathrm{CF_2ClCHFCl}
text
）二种化合物在同位素交换过程中对氘的竞争，以及利用多光子解离氟利昂-123a来分离氘同位素的可能性，李长林等[129]研究了氟利昂-123a的氘化反应动力学。精馏粗料得到纯氟利昂-123a其红外光谱与文献一致。从红外光谱仪测定含氢及含氘氟利昂-123a的线性吸收谱图看出，在
equation_inline
880 - 980\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text
区域内，
equation_inline

丙烯腈丙烯酸酯苯乙烯共聚物(AAS树脂)是将聚丙烯酸酯橡胶微粒分散于丙烯腈苯乙烯共聚物中，形成的接枝共聚物。由于用丙烯酸酯代替了丁二烯，提高了制品的耐气候性和耐老化性能，这种热塑性塑料常用于有紫外线照射的部件。在该共聚物的光谱（图4.37）中，应为三个单体单元组分的叠加光谱。

simple_table text 根据尼高力公司资料，氮氧化物的吸收峰位在 equation_inline 1630\mathrm{cm}^{-1} text 附近，是硝酸酯特征吸收峰。在 equation_inline 1100\mathrm{cm}^{-1} text 也经常看到一个相当强的吸收峰，这吸收峰常被一些氧化产物的吸收峰相重叠，但主要吸收位置证明是来自硫酸酯。测量这吸收值可以看出高碱性清净分散添加剂的消耗情况。有时在汽油机油使用过程中，样品在此位置也有强吸收。此时，硫的来源是从基础油和添加剂中来的。它的降解是氮氧化物的氧化能力造成的。 text （二）红外光谱用于监测内燃机油在使用过程中积炭的增长趋势 text 油品中积炭是由于柴油在发动机内不完全燃烧，或润滑油窜入燃烧室在高温下分解的烟炱等物质而形成的。积炭与炭黑很相似，它不溶解在油中，而是藉助于油品中清净分散剂的作用，使其与其他产物粘附在一起悬浮在油中。柴油机油中出现积炭是正常现象。汽油机油只有在延迟点火情况和使用汽、醇燃料时才产生积炭。积炭含量高对发动机磨损是有很大影响的。美国通用汽车公司研究室 Rounds equation_inline ^{[8]} text 认为积炭多会促使发动机磨损，因为抗磨剂和它的分解产物被炭粒所吸附，造成抗磨剂在油品中浓度不足，而使抗磨性能下降。上海石油商品研究所顾文良等 equation_inline ^{[9]} text 进行CD级柴油机油抗磨性能研究中也证实了上述观点。这是由于积炭含量高时，炭粒进入两个滑动表面之间，炭粒起磨粒作用，又加炭粒上粘附的酸性物质起腐蚀作用而引起的。因而监测在润滑油中积炭含量一直是人们很重视的一个问题。过去只能用物理方法测总不溶物含量。但总不溶物测试方法存在问题。目前高档次柴油机油中清净分散添加剂加量大，积炭悬浮在油中，采用离心法测总不溶物含量，测出结果偏小；另外，总不溶物组分除积炭外，还包含有另两种不溶解组分金属硫酸盐和高分子有机物油泥。实际上，总不溶物是积炭加氧化产物加外来污染物的总和。只有用红外光谱才能真实测出内燃机油中积炭的增长趋势。柴油机油中悬浮积炭能很容易地在红外光谱中检出。积炭没有一个特征吸收谱带，而是在4000—400cm equation_inline ^{-1} text 整个中红外区域都有吸收。悬浮积炭愈多，背景吸收也愈多。根据Chevron研究公司，Macgeeham等 equation_inline ^{[10]} text 试验证明：积炭在1870cm equation_inline ^{-1} text 处的红外吸收值和油品中积炭浓度呈线性关系，它服从比尔定律。因而可以从某一位置的吸收增加值来得出油品中含有的积炭水平。过去油品中积炭用透射池子测试时，它会产生散射。散射程度与样品中炭粒大小、炭粒数量是有关系的。散射影响还随着频率高低而改变，愈在高频率位置影响愈大，因而它会形成一条倾斜背景吸收，而影响谱图的显示。采用多重衰减全反射池子能克服这种影响。

混入润滑油中的污染物主要有：未燃烧完的汽油或柴油（称燃油稀释）、水、乙二醇和砂粒。（1）燃油稀释。柴油、汽油在发动机工作时可以通过两个渠道进入发动机润滑油中，一是在高燃气比状况下；二是在活塞环磨损后窜气进入。这部分燃油由于是从燃烧室来的，燃油中的轻组分已挥发了，只留下重组分。有个别发动机其燃油管路先通过缸体进行预热，此时也可能由于管路渗漏而进入。不管哪一种，只要超过
equation_inline
2\%
text
，就会降低润滑油的效率。过去曾采用常规闪点方法来测定其轻组分是很不科学的。用气相色谱方法测定，结果较为可靠，但手续麻烦。尼高力公司技术资料介绍：汽、柴油重组分一般用红外光谱方法测定也很难检测，原因是汽、柴油与润滑油一样都是碳氢化合物，其主要区别是汽、柴油平均分子量小，含芳香烃较多，红外光谱主要是测汽、柴油中残留芳香烃组分。因此用红外光谱测出的结果与其他方法测出的结果是有差别的，因为它们测量的参数内容不一样。其他文章介绍的红外光谱测试方法也都大同小异。汽油残余物中芳香烃含量较高，因而测试结果较为准确。（2）水或乙二醇。水或乙二醇是发动机冷却系统渗漏而渗入的，水分还可以从其他渠道如排气管、加油口盖等处进入。近年来有资料[11]表明，润滑油中存在有水分对添加剂的降解有很大影响，如30号QE级汽油机油中，当水含量在

聚氯乙烯通常可以通过悬浮聚合、乳液聚合、珠状聚合和本体聚合获得。乳液聚合常含有难以除去的乳化剂，珠状聚合获得的聚合物比乳液聚合纯度高些，本体聚合获得至聚合物不但纯度高，热稳定性和电性能皆好，溶液聚合仅用于氯乙烯共聚物的制备。 text
(一) 聚氯乙烯 text
聚氯乙烯是最早合成的热塑性树脂之一。纯聚氯乙烯是相当坚硬的角质状的半透明的固体，能够机械加工。其粉和纤维呈白色，棒状制品呈琥珀色。聚氯乙烯薄膜要撕破是很困难的，沿着剪口很易撕破，拉伸部位表现出乳白色的混浊。聚氯乙烯不溶于通常的溶剂中，但在四氢呋喃、环己酮和甲基环己酮中有相当好的溶解性能。工业产品的含氯量为55~57%。聚氯乙烯是一种多组分塑料，按照不同的用途，可以加入不同种类和不同含量的添加剂，因此得到不同物理机械性能的产品。如不加增塑剂的为硬聚氯乙烯，加入增塑剂的为软聚氯乙烯，加入大量增塑剂的聚氯乙烯可作为橡胶材料使用。氯乙烯分子中可能存在少量支链，在热或光的作用下，脱去氯化氢，形成共轭双键，导致聚合物变色。 text
聚氯乙烯通常可以通过悬浮聚合、乳液聚合、珠状聚合和本体聚合获得。乳液聚合常含有难以除去的乳化剂，珠状聚合获得的聚合物比乳液聚合纯度高些，本体聚合获得至聚合物不但纯度高，热稳定性和电性能皆好，溶液聚合仅用于氯乙烯共聚物的制备。 text
以游离基引发聚合制备的工业聚氯乙烯是头尾相接的无定形聚合物，有少量间规存在，约有5%的结晶度，这种聚合物没有明显的熔点，加热到120~160℃具有可塑性。提高聚合温度（如60℃）时间规序列含量会降低，相反，在较低的温度下有利于形成间规易结晶的聚合物。氯乙烯在脲的包合物中辐射引发聚合可以得到接近90%的间规高结晶度聚合物。等规聚氯乙烯至今尚未能制得。 text
用各种方法制造的工业聚氯乙烯的红外光谱（图5.1）是非常相似的。乳液聚合物由于含有乳化剂的吸收（
equation_inline
1053\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text
，
equation_inline
9.50\mu \mathrm{m}
text
）可以与珠状聚合物相区别。测定聚氯乙烯红外光谱的合适薄膜厚度为

聚氯乙烯通常可以通过悬浮聚合、乳液聚合、珠状聚合和本体聚合获得。乳液聚合常含有难以除去的乳化剂，珠状聚合获得的聚合物比乳液聚合纯度高些，本体聚合获得至聚合物不但纯度高，热稳定性和电性能皆好，溶液聚合仅用于氯乙烯共聚物的制备。 text

8210 油质分析仪经使用后，有以下几个特点。 text
仪器使用中注意事项有：（1）样品润滑油是非均质油状物，其中的氧化产物和污染物很容易下沉，因而在试验前必须激烈振荡，在临测试前最好还将油品例置一段时间。样品中若混有气泡，不影响测试结果。（2）样品必须处于室温状态，过冷、过热都会使晶体破裂。（3）硒化锌晶体很软很容易擦伤，在使用中需倍加小心。润滑油本身含有磨损下来的金属颗粒，在装样和清洗时都不能擦抹或擦洗，只能用聚四氟乙烯刮刀把样品轻轻摸涂，用面巾纸或脱脂棉轻轻按洗。 text
四、8210型油质分析仪的特点 text
8210 油质分析仪经使用后，有以下几个特点。 text
1. 该仪器在设计上采用了水平 ATR 池子优点多。(1) 使用极为方便。它只需将样品铺满在晶体上，不用控制它的厚度。清洗也方便。尤其对样品中难以清洗的粘附状积炭也能很容易地清洗干净，再配合定量分析软件，测试一个样品仅需 5 分钟时间，这对监控和油品研制过程中样品数量多的情况是很适用的。(2) 硒化锌晶体不溶于水，样品不需进行脱水处理。(3) 能适用于测试粘稠和含炭粒较多的样品。(4) 对水、乙二醇的最小检出量为
equation_inline
0.1\%
text
和
equation_inline
0.05\%
text
，完全能满足监控的要求（1992 年，伯乐公司 Digilab 研究室 Powell 等[20]曾怀疑水平 ATR 是否能检测出微量水和乙二醇）。水平 ATR 池子虽有以上优点，但硒化锌晶体太软，既便小心使用，也会有擦伤，更换晶体价格较贵。 text
2. 仪器对氧化物、硝化物的测定，都是在一定波数范围内取最大峰峰高来进行计算，这样设计比较合理。长期以来，国内很多单位考察油品的氧化程度都是以某一固定位置的峰高或峰面积来表示的。如1993年起用的中国石化总公司行业标准SH/T0070-91中规定
equation_inline
^{[21]}
text
：“红外光谱位于
equation_inline
1720cm^{-1}
text
波数处吸收值称为氧化值；红外光谱位于
equation_inline
1630cm^{-1}
text
波数处的吸收值称为硝化值”。还有的单位以
equation_inline
1703cm^{-1}
text
波数处峰面积来计算。其实，这种以固定波数处吸收值来指示油品氧化和硝化程度是不科学的。因为油品组分和仪器不同，对氧化、硝化吸收峰位置是有影响的，而且同一油品在试验过程中，取样时间不同，测的羰基吸收峰位置也是有所变化的，档次愈高的润滑油，使用添加剂品种和数量愈大，受影响程度也愈大。上海炼油厂生产的QE级汽油机油，其氧化产物吸收峰最高的位置为
equation_inline
1716cm^{-1}
text
，长城高级润滑油公司生产的CD级柴油机油使用600小时后，其氧化物最大吸收峰位于
equation_inline
1703cm^{-1}
text
处，上述两种油品在
equation_inline
1720cm^{-1}
text
处都没有吸收峰
equation_inline
^{[22]}
text
。而60年代油品如低档的汽油机油、柴油机油等，其添加剂量都加的很少，其氧化产物吸收峰一般在
equation_inline
1720cm^{-1}
text
处。所以根据油品的发展，这样设计是有道理的。

2. 仪器对氧化物、硝化物的测定，都是在一定波数范围内取最大峰峰高来进行计算，这样设计比较合理。长期以来，国内很多单位考察油品的氧化程度都是以某一固定位置的峰高或峰面积来表示的。如1993年起用的中国石化总公司行业标准SH/T0070-91中规定
equation_inline
^{[21]}
text
：“红外光谱位于
equation_inline
1720cm^{-1}
text
波数处吸收值称为氧化值；红外光谱位于
equation_inline
1630cm^{-1}
text
波数处的吸收值称为硝化值”。还有的单位以
equation_inline
1703cm^{-1}
text
波数处峰面积来计算。其实，这种以固定波数处吸收值来指示油品氧化和硝化程度是不科学的。因为油品组分和仪器不同，对氧化、硝化吸收峰位置是有影响的，而且同一油品在试验过程中，取样时间不同，测的羰基吸收峰位置也是有所变化的，档次愈高的润滑油，使用添加剂品种和数量愈大，受影响程度也愈大。上海炼油厂生产的QE级汽油机油，其氧化产物吸收峰最高的位置为
equation_inline
1716cm^{-1}
text
，长城高级润滑油公司生产的CD级柴油机油使用600小时后，其氧化物最大吸收峰位于
equation_inline
1703cm^{-1}
text
处，上述两种油品在
equation_inline
1720cm^{-1}
text
处都没有吸收峰
equation_inline
^{[22]}
text
。而60年代油品如低档的汽油机油、柴油机油等，其添加剂量都加的很少，其氧化产物吸收峰一般在
equation_inline
1720cm^{-1}
text
处。所以根据油品的发展，这样设计是有道理的。 text
3. 仪器能同时监控几项指标，测试结果重复性较好。润滑油在使用过程中的衰变情况仅靠氧化、硝化一二项指标来衡量是不够的，还要进行综合考虑。如燃油稀释、水污染、防冻液渗漏、积炭污染等对润滑油的性能也有很大影响，应一并考察。这几方面在仪器设计上都考虑到了。这为较全面地分析判断润滑油的质量变化打下了基础。由于有了定性、定量分析软件，减少了许多人为的误差，使测定结果更准确，更可靠。 text

text 近年来，8210油质分析仪改型为8210-E液体分析仪，在原有基础上，扩大了使用范围。Fuller等文章[26]中介绍，8210-E液体分析仪还可用于对新油、洗涤液、谷物糖浆等进行分析。在新油分析方面，该仪器可以放在船上、靠近码头处、油库等进行油料的接收化验。大家都知道，接收油品化验最频繁，使用的都是一般理化测试方法，提供信息极为有限。又加接收化验任务多，不管白天、黑夜，不管春、夏、秋、冬，槽车一到就要爬到槽车顶上取样、化验，样品合格后才能把油卸到库内，是很紧张的。若该仪器能承担这方面的任务，把在线分析用液体流通池子放在接收油料管线中进行自控，这将是一大突破，对仪器扩大使用是有相当大的潜力的。接收油料化验是用8210液体分析仪对油品进行快速分析。用谱库内标准产品谱图进行匹配。首先看接收油料是否是标名的油品。然后进行匹配，按匹配得分数判断油品好坏，是否符合质量要求。这一切都由计算机操作，速度是很快的。所谓标准产品谱图是这样制作的，将各工厂生产的同一种产品都分别制做谱图，把同一产品谱图平均起来建成一个标准产品谱图，放在谱库中，用来鉴别接收的油料。用匹配得分数作为质量监控的指示值。这样可以看出配方有无变化，质量有无问题，以及储存条件是否良好等。在洗涤液方面应用，它用于洗衣房洗涤液中，监控其有效组分的消耗情况，一般洗涤液中配方组分为： text 表 17-5 10W/30 柴油机油ⅢD 试验结果

第三节 FTIR 气体分析仪及其应用 text
在自然界，物质主要是以气态、液态、固态和等离子态的形式存在。除气态以外，其它态都是物质聚集态。所谓聚集态是指大量分子（或原子、离子）聚拢一起后所呈现的状态。同一物质在不同的条件（温度或压力等）下，可呈不同的聚集态。 text
聚集的气态又称为气体。自然界的气体种类繁多，来源亦各不相同。有来自地下称为天然气；人类活动的大气圈称为空气；出自各种生物器官内和生物腐烂后派生的气称为生物气；根据工业和农业的需求专门生产各种纯气；工矿企业生产和交通运输过程都会排放品种繁多的废气等等。长期以来，人们为了认识和研究各种气体的化学性质及其含量，必须用不同的分析和鉴定的方法。在常规分析中，通常应用传统的方法，例如气相色谱法、质谱法以及简单的化学比色法。然而，这些方法往往是分析速度慢、精确度低（如比色法）、价格昂贵（如质谱法），并且它们都很难实现“在线”质量控制。

(二) 氯化聚氯乙烯 text
氯化聚氯乙烯也是早已工业规模生产的产品，它是聚氯乙烯的氯化产物，是聚氯乙烯的重要改性产物之一。氯化聚氯乙烯可使未增塑的聚氯乙烯耐热性提高，最高连续使用温度由65°C提高到105°C。氯化聚氯乙烯比聚氯乙烯的溶解性能好，能溶于氯苯、丙酮和四氯乙烷等各种溶剂中。可以用于溶液纺丝制造氯纶纤维，由于它具有良好的粘接性能，可作涂料和粘合剂。氯化聚氯乙烯的含氯量达66—67%，氨取代后链节中主要以—CHCl—CHCl—结构为主。 text

（四）SFC/FTIR 联用 text
超临界流体色谱—傅氏红外光谱也是能用于煤液化产品分析的联用技术。SFC 是 80 年代方迅速发展起来的一种新型色谱，在 SFC 中，柱中固定相和 HPLC 所用相同，而其流动相则是用高于临界温度和临界压力的流体。它既不是气体，也不是液体，但兼有气体和液体的性质，即既有液体那样的溶解能力，又有气体那样的传递性质，而且最常用的流动相——超临界 CO₂ 的红外透过性能良好，低密度的 CO₂ 仅在 3650—3500cm⁻¹，2350cm⁻¹ 和 670cm⁻¹ 处出现吸收，常温常压下又为气体，非常适合与 FTIR 联用。在红外区完全透明的 Xₑ 也可作流动相
equation_inline
^{[44]}
text
。

（四）SFC/FTIR 联用 text
从图2-13的重建色谱图中可以更加清楚地看到TLC/FTIR的这种作用。这是上例中同一年轻烟煤的吡啶抽提物，它被TLC的反相板（
equation_inline
\mathrm{C_{18}}
text
板）展开，采用水-甲醇（40：6）作展开剂，测得各杯中物的光谱后，对光谱进行基线校正，并分别求取各光谱在
equation_inline
3100 - 2700\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text
，
equation_inline
1750 - 1600\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text
和
equation_inline
1590 - 1500\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text
区的吸光度积分值，以它作纵坐标，样品杯编号为横坐标作图，即得如图2-13所示的重建色谱图[43]。其中
equation_inline
3100 - 2700\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text
区是C-H键的伸缩振动区。由图可见，每个杯中的样品都含有C-H基团，
equation_inline
\mathrm{C = O}
text
伸缩振动的重建色谱图（
equation_inline
1750 - 1600\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text
）表明，该抽提物中含有三种羰基化合物，一种集中在15—21号杯内，另一种在以38杯为主的几个杯内，第三种则分布在最后几个杯中。17、38、52号杯中物的光谱显示，羰基吸收带的峰值分别位于
equation_inline
1745\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text
(17号杯)和
equation_inline
1740\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text
(38,52号杯)处，意味着它们都是脂类化合物。
equation_inline
1590 - 1500\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text
代表脂肪族杂环化合物的C-N振动吸收（38号杯中物的光谱显示，该带峰值位于
equation_inline
1512\mathrm{cm}^{-1}
text
处），重建色谱表明，这类化合物集中在37—39号杯中。由此可见，TLC的分离能力还是比较高的，重建色谱峰的变宽只是由于煤抽提物组分过于复杂所致。 text
图 2-13 年轻烟煤吡啶抽提物的 TLC/FTIR 重建色谱图 text
（四）SFC/FTIR 联用 text
超临界流体色谱—傅氏红外光谱也是能用于煤液化产品分析的联用技术。SFC 是 80 年代方迅速发展起来的一种新型色谱，在 SFC 中，柱中固定相和 HPLC 所用相同，而其流动相则是用高于临界温度和临界压力的流体。它既不是气体，也不是液体，但兼有气体和液体的性质，即既有液体那样的溶解能力，又有气体那样的传递性质，而且最常用的流动相——超临界 CO₂ 的红外透过性能良好，低密度的 CO₂ 仅在 3650—3500cm⁻¹，2350cm⁻¹ 和 670cm⁻¹ 处出现吸收，常温常压下又为气体，非常适合与 FTIR 联用。在红外区完全透明的 Xₑ 也可作流动相
equation_inline
^{[44]}
text
。 text
在常规样品分析中，SFC 和 FTIR 联用接口多采用耐高压的流动池，通常用内壁抛光的不锈钢管做成，管内径在 1—0.5mm 左右，长度在 1—10mm 之间，并用 ZnSe、ZnS 或 CaF₂ 作池窗片
equation_inline
^{[45]}
text
。但高压流动池并不适用于煤抽提物的分析，因为 CO₂ 是非极性流动相，用于含较多极性组分的煤抽提物时分离效果不好。为使分离得到改善，必须在流动相中加入少量（1—10%）甲醇或乙醇等改性剂。如用流动池测馏出物溶液光谱，改性剂的强吸收会严重干扰组分光谱，因此对这种特殊样品来说，最好采用在光谱测定前能消除流动相的接口。

(四) 聚氯乙烯共混物 text
为了改进聚氯乙烯的物理机械性能，特别是抗冲击性能，常常用其他树脂与聚氯乙烯共混。虽然是物理混合物，然而欲将共混的各组分完全分离是较困难的。与混合相似，还可进行接枝或嵌段共聚，这些共混、接枝或嵌段共聚物的光谱基本上为各均聚物光谱的叠加。 text
1. 聚氯乙烯和乙烯醋酸乙烯酯共聚物的共混物 text
聚氯乙烯和乙烯酯酸乙烯酯共聚物的共混物已广泛用作为热塑性树脂、涂料和粘合剂。该共混物，特别是高含量间规结构的聚氯乙烯用于共混，具有高冲击强度，它能溶于许多工业溶剂中，涂层薄膜具有高度的弹性。 text
该共混物的红外光谱(图5.12)主要是各个组分光谱特性的叠加,
equation_inline
1563cm^{-1}(6.40\mu m)
text
的吸收带大抵属于乳化剂（皂）。

十、拉曼光谱与红外光谱的关系
equation_inline
^{[16,18,22]} text
拉曼光谱与红外光谱一样，都能提供分子振动频率的信息，但它们的物理过程却不同。拉曼效应为散射过程，即拉曼光谱为发射光谱，红外光谱是吸收光谱，即与红外光谱中某一吸收峰频率能量相等的（红外）光子被分子吸收。 text
从分子结构性质变化角度看，拉曼散射过程来源于分子的诱导偶极矩，与分子极化率的变化相关；通常非极性分子及基团的振动导致分子变形，引起极化率变化，是拉曼活性的。红外吸收过程与分子永久偶极矩的变化相关，一般极性分子及基团的振动引起永久偶极矩的变化，故通常是红外活性的。

The two most important factors that would lead to multiplicative noise are shortterm variations in the integrated intensity of the source and variation of the responsivity of the detector elements with temperature. The temperature of each of these components would have to be controlled to the point that both the source intensity and detector responsivity would need to be stable to better than 10 ppm. The positions of every mirror and/or lens in the optical train and the concentration of water vapor would also have to be controlled carefully. Thus, in practice there are very few applications where the use of a stationary interferometer would seem to be beneficial in the laboratory. One area where they may be advantageous is for satellite sensing, where the high readout speed of array detectors would allow the spectrum of very small areas of Earth to be measured, and the use of a two-dimensional array detector would allow spatial and spectral resolution to be attained simultaneously. It should be noted, however, that stationary interferometers are limited in their resolution, especially at the longer wavelengths. The problem lies in the available sizes of one- or twodimensional arrays. At the short wavelengths, such as the visible or short-wavelength near infrared
equation_inline
( \lambda < 1 . 2 5 \mu \mathrm { m } )
text
, reasonably large arrays are economically attractive and technically feasible. As the wavelength becomes longer, linear arrays beyond 1024 pixels are not available at the time of this writing, to the best knowledge of the authors. Even if the centerburst were placed at one end of the array, which would preclude double-sided phase correction, the resolution would only be about
equation_inline
1 6 \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 } text
There are more subtle problems associated with interferometers of this type. Retardation is dependent on dispersion of the beam from the optical center of the interferometer. Unfortunately, this is not a linear function and retardation increases rapidly with dispersion. As a consequence, the interferogram may be sampled appropriately at the optical center of the interferometer, but at the extremes of the dispersion, the sampling interval is too large. This is a serious effect from which even relatively low-resolution stationary interferometers suffer. To complicate matters even more, the effect of dispersion is wavelength dependent, and longer wavelengths are affected to a greater extent than short wavelengths. For example, in some designs of stationary interferometers for long-wavelength measurements
equation_inline
( 1 . 1 < \lambda < 2 . 5 \mu \mathrm { m } )
text
, a 512-pixel linear array would be expected to yield a resolution of about
equation_inline
6 4 \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 }
text
if the centerburst were placed in the center of the array. In practice, the actual resolution ranges from about 160 to 200 cm <sup>1</sup>.

Several early FT-IR spectrometers were equipped with simple resistively heated wire coils, such as nichrome or Kanthal. These sources did not require water cooling but had a lower operating temperature and poorer emissivity than a Globar, and are rarely used today. Another time-tested, albeit also now rarely used mid-infrared source is the Nernst glower. Nernst glowers are fabricated from a mixture of refractory oxides and can be run several hundred degrees hotter than a Globar. The main disadvantage of the Nernst glower is the fact that the emissivity of the oxides from which it is composed,
equation_inline
\varepsilon ( \widetilde v )
text
, is quite low above
equation_inline
2 0 0 0 \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 }
text
. If only the region below
equation_inline
2 0 0 0 \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 }
text
is of interest, the Nernst glower is obviously a better source than a Globar. On the other hand, if the entire mid-infrared spectrum is to be measured with a Nernst glower, the SNR at high wavenumber will be low.

An analogous measurement with a reference cell in the beam can be used to determine the feasibility of any given experiment, as the noise on the spectral baseline can increase greatly in regions where the energy level of the background spectrum is low. Consider an example where the spectrum of a particular solute is to be measured. It is common to mount a cell containing the pure solvent in the infrared beam for measurement of the background spectrum. If the absorbance at the peak of a particular absorption band in the solvent spectrum is, say, 2.0 (percent transmis-
equation_inline
\mathrm { s i o n } = 1 . 0 \% )
text
, the noise level near the absorption maximum will be 100 times higher than the noise level of the corresponding measurement made with no solvent in the beam. Detection limits are, of course, far lower in window regions of the solvent spectrum, where minimal absorption is evident in the background spectrum. Ideally, the solvent should be selected so that the key solute bands absorb in the windows of the solvent spectrum. Of course, this is not always possible. For example, the amide I band of proteins absorbs very near the H O H bending mode of water. If the amide I band of a protein in aqueous solution is of interest, it is important to know how the noise varies across the protein spectrum after compensation for the absorption spectrum of water.

If the zero-energy offset extends into the spectrum above the detector cut-on, the photometric accuracy of the spectrometer can be affected by as much as 10%T [18]. The effect can readily be observed above the detector cutoff simply by measuring the spectrum of a polymer film that is thin enough that its transmittance over most of the spectrum is high, but thick enough that several bands have an absorbance greater than 3.0. 8.5.2. Changes in Modulation Efficiency text
Very small changes in the modulation efficiency of interferometers that occur during a scan can also affect the accuracy of the zero-energy level of spectra measured with a FT-IR spectrometer. These errors are manifested in a slightly different way to the effect of response nonlinearity. The most common way that the modulation efficiency changes from scan to scan is for the alignment of the moving optical element(s) of the interferometer to vary, as discussed in Chapter 5. The poorer the drive, the greater will be the effect on the modulation efficiency. Let us say that mirror jitter during the scan caused the modulation efficiency to vary between 100 and 98%, with an average value of 99%. Since the amplitude of the wings of the interferogram (i.e., the part of the interferogram that is displaced from the centerburst) is very low, the effect of a small change of the modulation efficiency on the wings is going to be correspondingly small. On an absolute (not relative) basis, there will be a much larger change in the value of the interferogram near the centerburst. The effect of the change in modulation efficiency will therefore be a change in the zero-energy level of the spectrum, for the same reason given above for the effect of response nonlinearity. However, because the modulation efficiency can both increase and decrease, the effect on the spectrum will be to cause the zeroenergy baseline to go either above or below the true zero. The end result is that if a series of spectra are measured sequentially, the transmittance at the center of a strong band will appear to vary. Even if the sample itself is not the limiting aperture, a small wavenumber shift may be seen if the sample is not placed at a constant angle to the infrared beam. As the beam traverses the sample, it may be refracted at an angle that displaces the image on the detector. This has the effect of slightly changing the pathlength of the beam through the interferometer; hence, the relationship of the infrared interferogram to the HeNe laser interferogram is altered, resulting in a small wavenumber shift. In addition, when a sample is tilted with respect to the beam, the pathlength within the sample is altered, and this may change the measured absorbance slightly. text
Other precautions must be taken when spectra are collected if high photometric precision (repeatability) is required. Photometric precision is not only restricted to quantitative analysis, but is also required for spectral subtraction (Section 9.3), and spectral search systems (Section 10.8). Repeatable sample preparation and placement is critical. If the aperture of the sample cell is small enough to become the limiting aperture in the spectrometer, any shift in the position of the sample from the center of the beam will cause a shift in wavenumber and possibly a change in the ILS function (Section 2.6). Consistent sampling conditions are a necessity for careful quantitative work. In transmission spectrometry it is critical to fill the entire accessory aperture with the sample. If the actual sample area is smaller than the beam that passes through the aperture, stray light or excess radiation will reach the detector (Figure 9.2). The radiation that does not pass through the sample provides a spurious signal to the detector, and this excess radiation establishes a minimum transmittance. That is, no matter how strongly a sample absorbs, no band can have a transmittance below the minimum value set by the unattenuated radiation. Figure 9.3a shows the transmittance spectrum of the C H stretching region of a strongly absorbing polyethylene film, and Figure 9.3b shows the same film when the sample covers only 75% of the beam aperture. The latter spectrum is considerably shifted in percent transmission to the first, with the true 100% line for the sample at 25%T. The phenomenon is clearly illustrated in Figure 9.3c and d, when the two spectra are plotted in absorbance where spectrum c corresponds to spectrum a. To avoid this type of problem, the sample should be masked, or a large enough sample should be used to fill the aperture of the accessory. Of course, care should be exercised when a sample is masked to avoid a wavenumber shift, as discussed above. text

PLS has several strengths or advantages over the other multivariate methods, as it combines the strengths of CLS and ILS. CLS provides full spectral coverage and improves the precision of the data, and ILS allows modeling of a specific component. PLS tends to be extremely robust and can analyze very complex mixtures. The shortcomings are rather minor. The calculations tend to be rather slow, but this is becoming a moot point as computer speeds continue to increase. PLS does require a large number of mixture spectra to yield precise conditions but typically only three to five times as many mixtures as constituents. text
There are two general classes of PLS algorithms, usually designated as PLS-1 and PLS-2. The major difference between the two PLS algorithms is that PLS-2 calculates all the scores and loadings at one time, with just one set of loadings for all the components, whereas PLS-1 calculates them separately. PLS-2 is an iterative method and the loadings and scores are calculated by a convergence method in which all the convergences are done on all the spectral and concentration scores and loadings at once. This makes the calculation fairly rapid and the advantages of PLS are maintained. For each loading, scores are calculated for each component in parallel, and convergence is completed on the scores and loading before subsequent scores and loadings are calculated. PLS-1 is a potentially more accurate algorithm, but since each component is calibrated independently, can be slow if the number of components is large. For the first loading, each score is calculated from the full absorbance and concentration data set. For subsequent loadings, both the loadings and scores are calculated from successive residuals. PLS-1 spectral loadings retain a much better correlation to the constituent spectra than the other multivariate methods, but at the price of time. Prediction in PLS-1 and PLS-2 follow the procedures to determine the loadings and scores; PLS-1 calculates each unknown concentration individually, whereas PLS-2 calculates them in parallel. text
The number of principal components that should be used for a PLS-1 or PLS-2 analysis is usually determined by first calculating the root-mean-square error of cross validation (RMSECV) using one principal component (PC.) The process is repeated using 2, 3, 4, and so on, PCs. Generally speaking, all multivariate analyses require that the algorithm being used should first be trained by measuring the spectrum of samples of known composition. The validity of the calibration for the type of samples measured must then be tested, ideally with an independent set of samples. Sometimes, the composition of samples in the calibration set is determined by mixing known weights or volumes of the components. For other types of samples, this simple approach may be impossible. For example, it is not reasonable to mix pure samples of starch, protein, oil, and water, then expect the spectrum to match that of wheat! 1.6. POLARIZED RADIATION text
If a beam of unpolarized electromagnetic radiation is transmitted in the z direction, the amplitudes of the components of the sinusoidally varying electric field in the x and y planes are identical. When the beam is passed through a polarizer, the component of the electric field in one plane is transmitted, as described in more detail in Chapter 12. For unoriented samples such as all gases and liquids and isotropic solids, the absorbance of all bands in the spectrum is independent of the orientation of the polarizer. If the molecules in a certain sample are preferentially oriented in a given direction, however, the component of the dynamic dipole moment derivative of each vibrational mode,
equation_inline
d \mu / d Q
text
, in the direction that the radiation is polarized will change as the polarizer is rotated. text
Since the largest intensity of each band is observed when the beam is polarized in the direction for which the change in dipole moment for that vibrational mode is greatest, important information on the orientation of samples can be derived by installing a polarizer in the beam. For example, one of the more important applications of the use of polarized light is the measurement of the orientation of the chains in drawn or extruded polymers. A more esoteric application is the estimation of the angle at which surfactants are adsorbed on the surface of water.

For unoriented samples such as all gases and liquids and isotropic solids, the absorbance of all bands in the spectrum is independent of the orientation of the polarizer. If the molecules in a certain sample are preferentially oriented in a given direction, however, the component of the dynamic dipole moment derivative of each vibrational mode,
equation_inline
d \mu / d Q
text
, in the direction that the radiation is polarized will change as the polarizer is rotated. text
Since the largest intensity of each band is observed when the beam is polarized in the direction for which the change in dipole moment for that vibrational mode is greatest, important information on the orientation of samples can be derived by installing a polarizer in the beam. For example, one of the more important applications of the use of polarized light is the measurement of the orientation of the chains in drawn or extruded polymers. A more esoteric application is the estimation of the angle at which surfactants are adsorbed on the surface of water. text
Several different types of reflection spectroscopy yield more information when the radiation is polarized. For example, very thin films of molecules adsorbed on the surface of metals only absorb radiation polarized parallel to the plane of incidence. The reflection of light from bulk samples depends on the polarization of the light with respect to the plane of the sample. The effective depth into a sample that can be sensed by internal reflection spectroscopy is also different for radiation polarized perpendicular and parallel to the surface. Polarized radiation may even be used to eliminate interference fringes from the spectra of thin polymer films. text
It is hoped that these few examples will give the less experienced reader an indication as to why FT-IR spectroscopy is even more popular today than when it was used primarily as a tool for structural elucidation.

Most samples to be investigated by mid-infrared spectrometry, except polymer films and KBr pellets, must be held between two windows. Glass cannot be used as a window material in the mid-infrared, and salt plates are used instead. The two most important properties of the materials that are used for infrared spectrometry are the cutoff and the refractive index; these parameters are listed in Table 11.1. text
11.1. CONDENSED-PHASE SAMPLES text
11.1.1. Window Materials text
Most samples to be investigated by mid-infrared spectrometry, except polymer films and KBr pellets, must be held between two windows. Glass cannot be used as a window material in the mid-infrared, and salt plates are used instead. The two most important properties of the materials that are used for infrared spectrometry are the cutoff and the refractive index; these parameters are listed in Table 11.1. text
11.1.2. Band Intensities text
The absorptivities of fundamental bands in the condensed-phase spectra of most samples vary by well over an order of magnitude, but the strongest band in the spectra of typical neat liquids or solids usually has an absorbance of between about 0.5 and 2 AU if the thickness of the sample is 10 mm. This is only a rule of thumb, however. The absorptivity of strong bands in the spectra of polar analyte is almost invariably greater than that of the stronger bands in the spectra of nonpolar analytes. For example, the four strongest bands in the spectrum of a 5-mm film of poly (ethylene terephthalate) are more intense than the strongest band in the spectrum of a 20-mm film of polystyrene.

11.1.4. Trace Analysis text
First let us distinguish between trace analysis and microsampling. Trace analysis by FT-IR spectrometry is the measurement of the spectrum of a minor component of a sample. Microsampling is the measurement of the spectrum of a very small amount of a pure material or major component of a mixture. It is not too difficult to obtain the spectrum of 1 ng of a pure solid or liquid, but it can be exceedingly difficult to obtain the spectrum of the same amount of the same material when it is present at a level of 1 ppm in 1 mg of a strongly absorbing matrix. The measurement is almost impossible if the most characteristic bands in the spectrum of the matrix and the analyte absorb at similar wavelengths. text
Let us recall the rule of thumb given at the start of this chapter (i.e., a strong band in a 10-mm film of a pure material has a typical absorbance of about 1 AU). Furthermore, we will assume that the strongest band in the spectrum of the analyte must have an absorbance of at least 0.001 AU (1 mAU) for the analyte to be identified above the noise level, interference by atmospheric water vapor, and small variations of the baseline.

To measure the spectrum of a gas or vapor, the sample must be contained in a gas cell of an appropriate pathlength. The standard length of a cell for the measurement of the spectra at relatively high partial pressures (0.1 to 0.01 atm) is 10 cm. Cells of pathlengths between 1 and 10 cm fit easily in the sample compartments of all benchtop FT-IR spectrometers. If the analyte is present at a lower partial pressure or has a very low absorptivity
equation_inline
( \mathbf { e } . \mathbf { g } . , \mathrm { H } _ { 2 } \mathbf { S } )
text
, a longer pathlength is needed. In this case, a cell in which the beam is multiply reflected should be used. This type of cell is commonly known as a White cell, after the designer of the original folded path cell, J. U. White [4], although several different variants of multipass gas cells have been reported. text

White cells with pathlengths between 1 and at least 200 m are commercially available from a variety of vendors. Concentrations of gases as low as 10 ppb (and even lower for compounds with bands of very high absorptivity) have been measured in such cells. By fabricating the cell body from quartz and surrounding the cell with banks of ultraviolet lamps, the mechanisms of gas-phase photochemical reactions can be studied. Some of the fundamental investigations into the formation of photochemical smog were performed by irradiating hydrocarbons present in air at a low parts-per-million level in a 400-m cell [9]. By measuring a series of spectra over a period of time, the mechanism and kinetics of the ensuing reactions could be followed, even though the products were present only at the low ppb level. text
Most White cells are designed to monitor static samples and do not have good flow characteristics. The ideal cell in this respect has a high pathlength/volume ratio, so that the contents are readily flushed out. An example of such a cell is an internally gold-coated light-pipe of the type used to monitor the effluent from a capillary gas chromatograph by FT-IR spectrometry (GC/FT-IR). As described in more detail in Chapter 23, a typical light-pipe designed for capillary GC/FT-IR is 10 cm in length and 1 mm in internal diameter (a volume of 80 mL). The reflection losses in such light-pipes are quite severe; a light-pipe with the dimensions given above has a transmission of less than 10%, so that a MCT detector is invariably used for GC/FT-IR measurements.

It is interesting to consider what would happen to the SNR of an IRRAS spectrum if the measurement were made with unpolarized light. When the beam of an FT-IR spectrometer is passed through a wire-grid polarizer oriented to transmit
equation_inline
p \mathrm { - }
text
or s-polarized radiation, the ratio of a single-beam spectrum measured in this way to the single-beam spectrum measured without a polarizer is about 30%. The noise level on the baseline of a spectrum measured at a certain resolution with a certain number of scans with the polarizer in place would therefore be about three times higher than for the baseline of the corresponding spectrum measured without a polarizer. The absorbance of a thin film on the surface of a metal when measured at approximately grazing incidence with unpolarized radiation is one-half of the absorbance of the same film measured with p-polarized light. Thus, the SNR of an IRRAS spectrum measured without a polarizer should actually be higher than the corresponding spectrum measured with p-polarized radiation. It would, therefore, appear logical that IRRAS spectra are better measured with unpolarized radiation than with p-polarized light. text
In practice, IRRAS spectra are almost invariably measured with p-polarized radiation. Because IRRAS spectra are usually so weak, the noise on the spectral baseline should be no greater than
equation_inline
\sim 1 \times 1 0 ^ { - 5 }
text
AU (10 mAU). To achieve this performance in a reasonable time, the measurement should be made with an MCT detector. However, so little radiation is lost in an IRRAS measurement that the power at the detector is very high. Under these conditions, the response of MCT detectors is usually highly nonlinear so that not only do photometrically inaccurate spectra result (see Section 8.6.1) but the SNR may be limited by digitization noise rather than detector noise (see Section 7.3). It is therefore necessary to attenuate the beam before making the measurement. It is far more efficient to attenuate the beam with a polarizer than with a screen or an iris because not only is the signal reduced by a factor of
equation_inline
{ \sim } 3
text
(reducing the effect of detector/amplifier nonlinearity), but the intensity of the absorption bands of the thin film doubles with respect to the same measurement made with unpolarized light.

For a number of reasons the intensity of an IRRAS spectrum of a very thin film is rarely the same as would be calculated from the corresponding transmission spectrum of the bulk analyte. For example, any interaction between the analyte and the metal will change the strength of the bonds involved and hence lead to changes in the frequencies and absorptivities of vibrational modes of the adsorbate. For example, when carbon monoxide adsorbs on a transition metal, the carbonyl stretching mode is usually shifted to a wavenumber that is at least 100 cm<sub>-</sub><sup>1</sup> below the fundamental frequency of gas-phase CO. In addition, the absorptivity of CO adsorbed on a metal surface is several times greater than the absorptivity of CO in the gas phase.

Besides the changes in wavenumber and absorptivity, which can be explained on chemical grounds, there is one other important difference between the spectra of surface and bulk species. For surface species, only those vibrational modes where the dipole moment derivative,
equation_inline
\mathtt { \hat { o } \mu / \hat { o }  { Q } } .
text
, has a component in a direction perpendicular to the surface will be seen in an IRRAS spectrum. This phenomenon has been called the surface selection rule. It is caused by the fact that a dipole at the surface of a metal will have an image inside the metal at the same distance from the surface. The net dipole moment of the analyte and its image must change with the normal coordinate of the vibration for the mode to be seen in an IRRAS spectrum. Consider, for example, two possible orientations of CO chemisorbed to a metal substrate: perpendicular and parallel to the surface. If the adsorbate is parallel to the surface, a positive charge is induced in the metal at the negatively charged end of the molecule, and a negative charge is induced in the metal at the positively charged end of the molecule, as shown schematically in Figure 13.16. The result of these image dipoles is that the dipole moment is always zero and hence there is no change in the overall dipole moment of the molecule and the band is forbidden. On the other hand, if the molecule is perpendicular to the metal surface, the image dipole is such that there is a large permanent dipole moment,
equation_inline
\mathtt { \hat { o } \mu / \hat { o }  { Q } }
text
is large, and a relatively strong band results.

It is caused by the fact that a dipole at the surface of a metal will have an image inside the metal at the same distance from the surface. The net dipole moment of the analyte and its image must change with the normal coordinate of the vibration for the mode to be seen in an IRRAS spectrum. As any compound in contact with the IRE produces a spectrum, clearly the only reasonable choice for a background or reference spectrum is the bare IRE. Under no circumstances should the clamp be closed on the IRE without the sample and used as a reference. Even with IREs that are used for liquid analysis, the single-beam spectrum of the clean IRE should be used for the background. For example, if the solution is aqueous and it is desirable to remove the water absorption, two separate background spectra should be recorded. One should be the absorbance spectrum of the aqueous solution referenced to an empty ATR cell, and the other should be the absorbance spectrum of water also ratioed to the spectrum of the empty ATR cell. A scaled subtraction of the water spectrum from the solution spectrum will generally produce better results than a ratio of the spectrum of the aqueous solution to that of pure water. This is because the solute displaces water from the solution, so that the amount of water that contributes to the solution and water spectra will not be identical, so they may not ratio correctly. Scaled subtraction, however, can correct for the difference provided that the solute does not cause a shift of the water band. text

The traditional way to measure spectra by ATR spectrometry is to use a single- or double-sided IRE that is large enough to accommodate a fairly large sample and allow for multiple reflections within the IRE. To accomplish this, many early IREs were about 25 to 50 mm in length, 10 to 25 mm in height, and 2 or 3 mm in thickness. The geometry of the IREs was either a parallelepiped or a vertical truncated triangular prism. The latter IRE is often incorrectly called a trapezoidal IRE, yet this name is so pervasive that we will reluctantly use this nomenclature. Schematic diagrams of typical optical paths for a vertical parallelepiped and a trapezoidal prism are shown in Figure 15.5a and b, respectively. In both geometries the beam from the interferometer is directed at
equation_inline
9 0 ^ { \circ }
text
to the narrow dimension (the entrance) of the IRE. At this angle, reflection losses as the beam enters and exits the IRE are minimized. As the IRE is relatively thin, the beam reflects multiple times before emerging from the IRE. The multiple reflections increase absorbance of bands in ATR spectra, but do not, of course, change the depth of penetration of the evanescent wave. Thus, the sensitivity of detection for minor components is improved. The number of reflections can be calculated rather simply with trigonometry, although the suppliers of IREs and ATR accessories generally provide the number of reflections on request. text

By far the greatest number of users of diffuse reflection accessories simply want to measure the spectrum of a powdered sample. Samples can be prepared for DR spectrometry much more quickly than KBr disks or mineral oil mulls. Organic samples are usually mixed with 10 to 100 times their weight of a powdered alkali halide (called a diluent in this chapter) and ground until their particle size is about 2 mm. If a ball mill such as a Wig-L-Bug (Crescent Manufacturing Company, Chicago, Illinois) is used, this procedure takes only about 2 minutes. In this device, the sample is loaded into a stainless steel vial along with two ball bearings. The vial is rapidly moved in a figure-of-eight motion, allowing the balls to crush the sample very quickly. If inorganic materials are to be studied, the instantaneous pressure in the vial may lead to ion exchange between the sample and the diluent. This is particularly easy when KBr is used as the diluent. In such cases the sample should be ground separately from the diluent and the two powders mixed after the grinding step. When the sample is softer than the diluent, it may also adhere to the walls of the vial, so that the concentration of the mixture is less than would be expected from the amount of sample and diluent that were weighed into the vial. For quantitative DR measurements, it has been found to be quite difficult to prepare samples of accurately known concentration for calibration. Hamadeh et al. [13] have shown that shaking the sample and diluent together in a ball mill without loading the ball bearings in the vial gives very uniform dispersions. text

A simple way of preparing very hard samples for DR spectrometry is to use fine silicon carbide paper (sometimes known as emery paper) to abrade some of the sample. The ratio of the single beam spectrum of the emery paper after and before abrading the sample is often very similar to the transmittance spectrum of the sample and allows a rapid identification to be made. This technique is particularly useful for thermosetting polymers. Another application is the characterization of samples that are too large to bring into the laboratory. For example, the spectrum of the paints of cars involved in an accident may be obtained by transferring the paint onto a disk of emery paper at the site of the accident and bringing the disk to the lab for measurement. text
Another application of mid-infrared DR spectroscopy is the measurement of reacting samples in a controlled atmosphere. A number of cells has been designed to be compatible with commercially available DR accessories. A home-built accessory [14] is shown in Figure 16.5 and a typical commercially available accessory is shown in Figure 16.6. The efficiency of these accessories is quite low, so that they are generally used in conjunction with an MCT detector. When the cells are used at high temperature, a considerable amount of unmodulated thermal radiation is focused onto the detector element, promoting electrons from the valence band to the conduction band and reducing the response to modulated radiation (i.e., the interferogram) and hence the signal-to-noise ratio of the spectrum. This is the reason why the device shown in Figure 16.5 allows for water cooling.

A simple way of preparing very hard samples for DR spectrometry is to use fine silicon carbide paper (sometimes known as emery paper) to abrade some of the sample. The ratio of the single beam spectrum of the emery paper after and before abrading the sample is often very similar to the transmittance spectrum of the sample and allows a rapid identification to be made. This technique is particularly useful for thermosetting polymers. Another application is the characterization of samples that are too large to bring into the laboratory. For example, the spectrum of the paints of cars involved in an accident may be obtained by transferring the paint onto a disk of emery paper at the site of the accident and bringing the disk to the lab for measurement. text

These cells have proved useful for the measurement of a wide variety of applications, including the study of adsorption and catalytic and weathering reactions. In spectral regions where the absorptivity of the adsorbent is low, the sensitivity of DR spectrometry to small amounts of adsorbates is very high. For example, the spectrum that results when carbon monoxide is adsorbed on an alumina-supported rhodium catalyst, when the concentration of rhodium metal is 1% and 5%, is shown in Figure 16.7. It may be noted that good spectra of the same chemical system were measured on the accessory described by Hamadeh et al. [14] when the rhodium concentration is only 0.01%, the CO pressure is 1 millitorr, and spectra close to the detection limit were obtained at a rhodium concentration of 0.001% and a CO pressure of 2 millitorr [15]. Such good sensitivity can be found in spectral regions only where the absorbent has low absorption. If the band of the adsorbate is located in a spectral region where the adsorbent has a very high absorptivity, it is unlikely that any band due to the adsorbate will be seen, no matter how high its surface coverage.

Near-infrared (NIR) spectra are rarely used to identify materials, but NIR spectroscopy has nonetheless assumed a role of great importance for contemporary analytical chemists. Near-infrared (NIR) diffuse reflection spectroscopy became of great importance in the 1970s, when it was shown that the concentration of protein, oil, and water in cereals could be measured accurately from their DR spectra measured between 2500 and 1100 nm (4000 to
equation_inline
{ \sim } 9 0 0 0 \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 } )
text
. Today, many types of solids are analyzed by measuring their NIR DR spectrum. Unlike the case for mid-infrared spectra, NIR spectroscopy is almost never used for structural elucidation. Instead, spectra of samples of known composition are regressed against calibrations standards of known composition. In fact, it could be argued that much of the impetus toward the development of modern chemometrics is derived from the need to obtain accurate quantitative information from the NIR DR spectra of agricultural commodities. text

FT-NIR spectrometers would give these instruments a considerable advantage over single channel instruments, such as the scanning monochromator or AOTF. When fairly high resolution or a very precise wavenumber scale is needed (as it may be for the analysis of pharmaceuticals), FT-NIR spectrometers have a strong advantage over the other types of spectrometers. However, NIR bands are usually quite broad in the spectra of most agricultural commodities, and high resolution is rarely required. In this case, the problems associated with a nonlinear detector response when the energy being measured is very high (as it is near the interferogram centerburst) can degrade the photometric accuracy of FT-NIR spectrometers and measurements are better made using either a single- or multichannel spectrometer. text

Neither type of reference is perfect, with ceramic disks having weak absorption bands caused by adsorbed water and PTFE disks having weak but reproducible bands caused by overtones of the C–F stretching modes. The best compromise is the use of a roughened gold reference. Since most NIR DR spectra are converted to log(1/R), errors in the baseline are less important and easily corrected [4]. text
As noted above, diffuse reflectance spectra are measured by calculating the ratio of the single-beam spectrum of the sample and that of a suitable reference. For midinfrared DR spectrometry measured using accessories of the type shown in Figures 16.2 and 16.3, the best reference is almost invariably the same material that was used as a diluent. KBr powder is frequently used for this purpose, but KBr is soft and not easily ground and quite hygroscopic. As a result of strong O–H stretching band of water, the baseline of mid-infrared DR spectra in the region between 3200 and
equation_inline
3 8 0 0 \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 }
text
is often degraded, making it difficult to decide whether broad bands are due to the analyte or water adsorbed on the surface of the KBr. NaCl can also be used but shows strong absorption below
equation_inline
7 0 0 \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 }
text
. A good compromise is KCl, which is harder and less hygroscopic than KBr and allows spectra to be measured to about
equation_inline
5 5 0 \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 }
text
. One final problem that may be noted with all alkali halides is that it is difficult to obtain them completely free of nitrate. As a result, even when the nitrate concentration is as low as 0.01%, a sharp band at
equation_inline
1 3 8 0 \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 }
text
is often seen in the spectrum. An alternative to alkali halides is diamond dust. Diamond powder is inexpensively available as an abrasive. Diamond does have a strong absorbance at
equation_inline
{ \sim } 2 2 0 0 \mathrm { c m } ^ { - 1 }
text
, but this is relatively broad and does not obscure <sup></sup>the spectrum in this region. Diamond is very hard, but it is not hydroscopic. text
An alternative reference material is a diffuse gold disk, sold commercially as InfraGold [12]. This is the recommended reference for all measurements made using an integrating sphere, as its reflectance properties are accurately known. Scattering from a gold surface is different from scattering from a powdered salt reference, so that the baseline of the reflectance spectrum measured using accessories such as those shown in Figures 16.2 and 16.3 is often well displaced from 100%. As noted above, if spectra are converted to the Kubelka–Munk function, baseline errors can lead to variations in the band intensity. text

TIRES and TIRTS have many of the same properties as photoacoustic spectrometry (see Chapter 20), in that they are largely insensitive to sample morphology and to the optical properties of the sample, such as scattering coefficient and frontsurface reflection. Similarly, TIRES and TIRTS spectra are also largely unaffected by the sample backing (if any) and the surrounding atmosphere, although emission from hot water vapor and carbon dioxide must sometimes be subtracted from the spectrum after the measurement. text
Typical TIRES spectra are shown in Figure 17.6. The lower two traces of Figure 17.6a are the spectrum of a 3-mm-thick sample of polycarbonate measured by uniformly heating the sample to
equation_inline
9 1 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C } \ ( \mathrm { A } )
text
and the corresponding spectrum of carbon black at the same temperature (B). Both spectra are shown as measured (i.e., neither spectrum was corrected for the instrument response function). Since the polycarbonate sample was thick enough to act as a blackbody, both spectra are essentially identical. The top spectrum, which was measured by TIRES, obviously has more discrete spectral structure. The top spectrum of Figure 17.6b shows the emittance spectrum that was calculated by ratioing spectra A and B, again demonstrating the fact that a thick sample has an emittance very similar to that of a blackbody. The lower spectrum is the result of ratioing the TIRES spectrum shown in Figure 17.6a to the blackbody spectrum, B. Also shown is an absorption spectrum of the polycarbonate sample, which was actually measured by photoacoustic spectroscopy (PAS). Although PAS and TIRES yield spectra with equivalent information and the photoacoustic spectrum is less noisy, the sample does not have to be enclosed in a vibration-free enclosure isolated from all the sound in the room for TIRES measurements. Thus, TIRES is far more appropriate for process analysis than (PAS). The emission spectra of the same 3-mm-thick polycarbonate sample at 23 and 132 C measured with and without cooling by a jet of cold gas are shown in Figure 17.7.

18.2.3. Collection Optics text
In any Raman measurement, it is critically important to collect as many photons emitted from the sample as possible. It is a general rule of Raman spectrometry that the focal ratio of the collection optics should be as close to
equation_inline
f / 1
text
as possible. For dispersive Raman spectrometry, the monochromator usually has f/4 optics, so that the beam must be magnified by a factor of 4 at the entrance slit of the monochromator. Since this slit is typically 100 mm in width, the diameter of the sample that is being measured is only about
equation_inline
2 5 \mu \mathrm { m }
text
. For a typical two-beam interferometer, the equivalent entrance aperture has a diameter that is closer to 4 mm (Jacquinot’s advantage). Thus, in this case, all the photons from a 1-mm-diameter spot can be collected. The power density of the laser at the sample can therefore be reduced significantly, concomitantly decreasing the probability of degradation of the sample. This subject is discussed in far greater detail in an excellent article by Schrader [7].

Two examples will be given to demonstrate the advantage of FT-Raman spectrometry with 1064-nm excitation over CCD-Raman spectrometry for real-world samples. In the first, spectra of two explosives, trinitrobenzaldehyde and hexanitrobiphenyl, were measured with an FT-Raman spectrometer and a CCD-Raman spectrometer equipped with a 782-nm diode laser [13]. The spectra are shown in Figure 18.10. Although both of these explosives were colorless, fluorescent impurities were present at a high enough concentration to give rise to an intense sloping baseline in both spectra measured with 782-nm excitation. This baseline could be removed by standard baseline-correction software, but the signal-to-noise ratio of the resulting spectrum had been degraded by photon shot noise caused by the fluorescence.

Two examples will be given to demonstrate the advantage of FT-Raman spectrometry with 1064-nm excitation over CCD-Raman spectrometry for real-world samples. In the first, spectra of two explosives, trinitrobenzaldehyde and hexanitrobiphenyl, were measured with an FT-Raman spectrometer and a CCD-Raman spectrometer equipped with a 782-nm diode laser [13]. The spectra are shown in Figure 18.10. Although both of these explosives were colorless, fluorescent impurities were present at a high enough concentration to give rise to an intense sloping baseline in both spectra measured with 782-nm excitation. This baseline could be removed by standard baseline-correction software, but the signal-to-noise ratio of the resulting spectrum had been degraded by photon shot noise caused by the fluorescence. text
In the second application, it was shown that softwoods and hardwoods could be distinguished through their FT-Raman spectra [14]. All the woods were colored to a greater or less extent, and useful spectra could not be obtained by CCD-Raman spectrometry, even with 782-nm excitation. Representative spectra are shown in Figure 18.11. Even when 1064 nm was used, there was a relatively weak background caused by fluorescence and the spectra shown in Figure 18.11 were obtained after baseline correction.

18.5. SUMMARY text
It is a little-known fact that Raman spectrometers first became commercially available in the 1930s, while the development of infrared spectrometers was triggered a decade later by World War II. The development of inexpensive double-beam infrared prism and grating spectrometers in the 1950s and 1960s heralded the great popularity of infrared spectroscopy for the structural elucidation of organic compounds. Raman spectrometers did not meet with the same approval from the analytical marketplace, in large part because of their instrumental complexity, relatively high cost, the long measurement time required to obtain a spectrum with a mercury arc source, the low signal-to-noise ratio of most Raman spectra once they had been measured, and the fact that so many samples fluoresced when illuminated with visible radiation, completely masking the Raman spectrum. Even the commercial introduction of high-power gas lasers, such as HeNe, Ar<sub>þ</sub>, and HeCd, in the early 1970s did not greatly change this state of affairs. The demonstration that Raman spectra could be measured with near-infrared excitation, either with 1064-nm excitation with an FT-Raman spectrometer or with 785- or 830-nm excitation with a CCD-Raman spectrometer, changed this situation radically. They recommend that after the ratio of the single-beam PA spectrum of a sample to a carbon-black reference has been calculated, the spectrum should be scaled so that its maximum value corresponds to 90% and the minimum to 5%. Water vapor is one of the biggest sources of interference in PA/FT-IR spectra. Very often, water vapor will be desorbed from the surface of the sample when the beam from the hot IR source is focused on it. Since the photoacoustic effect is much stonger for gases than for solids, water vapor lines can be more intense than the PA spectrum of the solid sample. The best way to ameliorate this problem is to mount the sample on a desiccant and wait about 5 minutes, while the water vapor that has desorbed from the sample is adsorbed by the desiccant.

21.2. DIRLD SPECTROMETRY WITH A STEP-SCAN FOURIER TRANSFORM SPECTROMETER text
Because the modulation frequency of a conventional rapid-scanning spectrometer varies with wavenumber, these instruments cannot be used in a fashion analogous to the monochromator setup shown in Figure 21.1, but a step-scan interferometer could be.
